motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) prescribes stricter conditions for labor immigration with a raised income threshold toward the median wage level. The government's proposal for a raised support requirement is a direct application of this commitment. KD, as a party to the Tidö agreement, supports the committee's proposal to approve the bill and rejects the motions from V and MP.

citations.quote: An investigative process shall be commissioned with the mandate to review the regulatory framework for labor immigration in order to raise the income threshold.
citations.princip: raised income threshold for labor immigration

citations.quote: The starting point shall be that work permits are only to be granted if the work to which labor immigration is directed normally has a wage level corresponding to the median wage.
citations.princip: work permit at median wage level

citations.quote: A strict migration policy is required to address integration problems and exclusion.

motivering: The Tidö agreement contains a specific program for requirements-based integration policy with ongoing investigations into civic orientation and SFI (Swedish for Immigrants). The committee rejects C's and MP's motions on the establishment of newly arrived women, referring to the fact that investigative work is already underway, which exactly mirrors the Tidö agreement's reform program. KD supports the committee's rejection line.

citations.quote: To introduce a requirements-based integration policy, where those who have been in Sweden for an extended period must take responsibility for becoming part of Swedish society.

An inquiry shall be appointed with the mandate to propose changes to the rules on societal introduction for asylum seekers, civic orientation (samhällsorientering) for newly arrived immigrants, and SFI (Swedish for Immigrants) instruction.
citations.princip: ongoing inquiry into civic introduction and SFI

motivering: The committee's proposal files the written communication on the PLO model without changing the system, which is compatible with KD's role as a governing party. KD has committed in the Tidö agreement to support the government's budget process. The motion (V motion item 9) lacks support in KD's documents. The committee's noting that transparency should be improved is unproblematic for KD.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.
citations.princip: loyalty requirement of the budget cooperation

motivering: KD supports active state governance of state-owned companies, including steering Vattenfall toward expansion of schedulable fossil-free electricity production. The committee's proposal to file the 2022 government ownership statement and reject the opposition motions is compatible with this. The motions are not KD's own demands, and KD votes Yes as a governing party.

citations.quote: Vattenfall should immediately begin planning new nuclear power at Ringhals and other suitable locations. New governance of Vattenfall, including through a new ministerial group, with participation from civil servants, which is tasked with steering Vattenfall in a direction toward becoming a leader in the expansion of schedulable, fossil-free electricity production.
citations.princip: Active state governance of state-owned companies

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.

motivering: The Tidö agreement commits KD to reforming the General Inheritance Fund (Allmänna arvsfonden) toward better results reporting, democratic values, and expanded victim support work. Filing the previous government's written communication on the 2021 administration and rejecting the opposition motions is compatible with KD pursuing its own reform agenda for the fund. The committee's proposal is supported.

citations.quote: An investigative process shall be conducted to ensure that organizations and associations receiving funds from the General Inheritance Fund use them correctly with clear results reporting and that they adhere to democratic values. The starting point shall be that the distribution of the Inheritance Fund's resources shall be changed to include, among other things, victim support work.
citations.princip: Reform of the Inheritance Fund's orientation

motivering: KD is part of the government's parliamentary base and the committee — whose majority includes KD — assesses that the government has sufficiently addressed the Swedish National Audit Office's recommendations through the National Board of Health and Welfare's (Socialstyrelsen) ongoing work. The Tidö agreement highlights strengthened monitoring of healthcare efficiency but provides no basis for demanding additional measures beyond what the government is already taking. KD supports filing the written communication and rejecting SD's motion.

citations.quote: The Health and Social Care Inspectorate (IVO) or the Agency for Health and Care Services Analysis should be given the authority to also review regions' and municipalities' activities regarding medical outcomes. The reporting of healthcare quality at the provider level shall be strengthened.
reduce the need for costly agency staff

motivering: The Tidö agreement prescribes that the waste incineration tax shall be reviewed to strengthen combined heat and power, and the new government plans to abolish it in January 2023. GDP-indexing a tax that is about to be abolished contravenes the Tidö agreement's energy policy. The committee's rejection of the previous government's bill is thus in line with KD's commitments.

citations.quote: The combined heat and power tax, the waste incineration tax, and the tax on bio-oil are reviewed to create better conditions for combined heat and power.
The usefulness of subsidies, policy instruments, and state organization in the climate area is reviewed.

motivering: Defense and total defense are not a specific cooperation project in the Tidö agreement, but KD's election manifesto identifies 'International Responsibility' as a priority policy area. The Defense Committee's proposal to reject all motions referring to ongoing work is consistent with KD's position as a governing party. KD supports the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: INTERNATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY
citations.princip: International responsibility as a KD priority

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.

motivering: The committee's proposal rejects the Left Party's motion for increased resources. The Tidö agreement establishes that state funds as a general rule shall be performance-based, and that the cooperation parties do not cooperate with other parties in these matters. KD's reform orientation emphasizes efficiency over unspecified resource increases proposed by the opposition.

citations.quote: The cooperation also entails that the constituent parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on matters covered by the directives of the cooperation projects.
The starting point shall be that state funds as a general rule are performance-based with clear follow-up.

motivering: The earnings ceiling (fribeloppet) in the student loan system is not addressed in KD's election manifesto or the Tidö agreement. KD as a governing party supports the committee's rejection of C's and other motions with reference to existing provisions.

citations.quote: More profitable to move from welfare benefits to work, pursue education, and take on greater responsibility at work. This concerns both effective benefit systems and taxation of earned income.

motivering: Confidentiality for individuals' personal data in electricity support cases enables the correct handling of the 'high-cost protection for affected households' that KD has committed to in the Tidö agreement. citations.quote: A high-cost protection for affected households and businesses as soon as practically possible — with retroactive payment.

motivering: KD's election manifesto highlights that the whole of Sweden must function and that the conditions for living and operating outside the major cities must be improved — the so-called heartland (hjärtlandet). KD as a governing party supports the committee's rejection of the opposition motions.

citations.quote: The whole of Sweden must function and it must be possible to live and operate even outside the major cities.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.

motivering: The Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) explicitly establishes that the Settlement Act (bosättningslagen) shall be reviewed and eventually abolished in favor of a system with greater municipal influence. The motions by MP, C, and S regarding the Settlement Act go in a different political direction. The committee's rejection is consistent with the line of the Tidö Agreement, and KD supports it.

citations.quote: The Settlement Act/Placement Act (bosättningslagen/anvisningslagen) should be reviewed with regard to the weighting of the factors governing the distribution of newly arrived migrants, and the housing situation in a municipality should constitute an additional factor. To introduce a requirements-based integration policy, whereby those who remain in Sweden over the long term shall take responsibility for becoming part of Swedish society.

motivering: A new Riksbank Act (riksbankslag) that strengthens the independence of the Riksbank and clarifies the mandate of monetary policy supports the stable financial framework that the Tidö Agreement presupposes for responsible economic policy. KD rejects V's motion against the Act and supports the committee's proposal that the new Riksbank Act be adopted.

citations.quote: The budget agreement rests on the premise that the budget framework remains fixed and that the budget is decided in its entirety.
citations.princip: Stable fiscal and monetary policy framework

citations.quote: The overall direction of economic policy during the term of office shall be to counteract unemployment and strengthen Sweden's capacity for growth.

motivering: KD's election manifesto highlights that the right of ownership is under threat and protects rural property owners. A pre-emption law (förköpslag) that grants municipalities the right to purchase properties limits precisely that right of ownership. The committee's rejection of V's and S's motions on a pre-emption law is therefore consistent with KD's principled property-protection perspective.

citations.quote: the right of ownership over the forest is under threat
Facilitate employee ownership and generational transfers of businesses — so that more businesses can be continued by the staff if the owner wishes to retire.

motivering: V's motion, claim 2, on moderation in gambling marketing is rejected by the committee majority. KD has no documented commitments in the Tidö Agreement or its election manifesto that support V's specific position, and as a governing party KD follows the committee majority that rejects the motion.

citations.quote: The cooperation also entails that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the matters covered by the directives of the cooperation projects.
We achieve that by promoting, in our democracy, good values such as compassion, responsibility, stewardship, honesty, moderation, and gender equality.
citations.princip: Moderation as a value without a specific statutory requirement

motivering: The Tidö Agreement explicitly commits to developing the role of pharmacies in the care chain and to introducing a pharmacist range (farmaceutsortiment — an intermediate tier between over-the-counter and prescription-only products). The government's communication welcomes the Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) review of pharmacy supervision and signals measures for improved oversight, which is consistent with this. The committee's rejection of V's and C's motions supports the government's own supervisory reform.

citations.quote: Offer certain services such as health check-ups (in addition to the current blood pressure checks, etc.). Introduce a pharmacist range (farmaceutsortiment), an intermediate tier between over-the-counter and prescription-only.
citations.princip: The expanded role of pharmacies in healthcare

citations.quote: The state shall take greater responsibility for the strategic planning of healthcare, the placement of highly specialized care, emergency preparedness, and long-term staffing.

motivering: An independent dispute-resolution body for collective tenancy disputes streamlines the rental market and reduces financial uncertainty in the event of a negotiation breakdown — in line with the Liberals' demand for a well-functioning housing market with orderly rules. Rejecting V's motions and supporting the proposal contributes to the market functionality that L's housing policy presupposes.

citations.quote: In order to increase the construction of more rental apartments and shorten the queues, we want to combine strong security of tenure with allowing the rent in newly built rental apartments to be freely agreed between landlord and tenant.
The experience of the sense of freedom that comes with one's own home is something that many more people shall be able to enjoy.
citations.princip: The functioning of the housing market

motivering: L's election manifesto (point 38) explicitly rejects high-speed rail and prioritizes remedying existing bottlenecks. The committee's formal request (tillkännagivande) to say no to HSR (high-speed rail) mirrors exactly this party position. Rejecting the listed opposition motions (V, MP, C, SD, S) is consistent with L's role as a government-supporting party.

citations.quote: We want to build away the bottlenecks in the rail network so that trains run on time here and now, rather than spending hundreds of billions on a high-speed railway that will not even be ready in 20 years.

motivering: The Liberals have a strong commitment to a greatly strengthened total defence (totalförsvar), including cyber and intelligence capabilities. As a governing party, L supports the committee's assessment that work is already under way on cyber policy through the new government's defence investments. The motions from C, SD, and S do not replace the government's ongoing work, and L votes Yes to the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: Sweden needs a considerably stronger military defence than today.
We therefore want to see a defence appropriation of 2 per cent of GDP as early as 2025, thereby creating sufficient conditions to strengthen both the Army, the Navy and the Air Force.

motivering: The Liberals want to reach a defence appropriation of 2 per cent of GDP as early as 2025 in order to strengthen the Army, the Navy, and the Air Force. The Defence Committee's proposal entails accelerated rearmament of SEK 94 billion and appropriation authorizations of SEK 173 billion, exactly in line with L's defence policy. Through the Tidö Agreement, L supports the government's budget and rejects SD's and C's alternative motions.

citations.quote: We therefore want to see a defence appropriation of 2 per cent of GDP as early as 2025, thereby creating sufficient conditions to strengthen both the Army, the Navy and the Air Force.

Sweden needs a considerably stronger military defence than today.

citations.quote: It should simply pay to take personal responsibility for one's own financial future.

motivering: The reform of AP7 (the Seventh Swedish National Pension Fund) and the default option (förvalsalternativet) strengthens the pension system's sustainability and return potential, in line with the Liberals' goal of strengthening pensioners' finances and promoting pension saving. Rejecting the Left Party's motion is natural since the party's position does not align with the Liberals' market-friendly pension policy.

citations.quote: Higher pensions and favored pension saving. We want to continue to strengthen the incomes of Sweden's pensioners so that it has always been worth having worked.
Develop proposals on how pensioners' finances can be strengthened and freedom of choice protected.

motivering: The Tidö Agreement prescribes an inquiry into civic orientation (samhällsorientering) for newly arrived migrants and Swedish for Immigrants (SFI), which is why the committee's rejection of C's and MP's motions is justified by the fact that work is already under way within the coalition's own framework. L shares the goal that more newly arrived women should enter employment, but implementation takes place within the joint reform work. L votes Yes with the committee.

citations.quote: an inquiry shall be appointed with the remit to propose changes to the rules on civic introduction (samhällsintroduktion) for asylum seekers, civic orientation (samhällsorientering) for newly arrived migrants, and Swedish for Immigrants (SFI) tuition.

motivering: The Liberals' labour-market line aims to make it simpler and cheaper to hire and to restore the work-first principle (arbetslinjen). The motions from V and MP on restrictions for fixed-term employment, staffing agencies, and posting of workers run counter to this flexibility line. The committee's rejection of these motions is therefore directly consistent with L's documents.

citations.quote: More entrepreneurs and business owners create more jobs and greater prosperity. That is why we want it to become simpler and cheaper to hire by reducing employers' social contributions for both small-business owners and for those who want to hire young people.

Restore the work-first principle (arbetslinjen). Sweden is still one of the countries in the world with the highest taxes on labour. This means that work and effort pay off less here – and sometimes not at all.

motivering: The constitutional amendment enables the freedom of association for terrorist organisations to be restricted by ordinary legislation, a step that the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) explicitly prescribes in the form of constitutional amendments to criminalise participation in and association with criminal organisations. The Liberals want to combat Islamists and criminal clans that threaten social cohesion and pose a separatist danger. Confirming the dormant proposal from April 2022 is fully consistent with this line.

citations.quote: It shall be a criminal offence to participate in criminal gangs. Proposals for constitutional amendments are being developed to enable the criminalisation of participation in, and association with, criminal organisations.
Islamists and criminal clans are exacerbating segregation and threatening social cohesion in Sweden. We want to take back power from separatists in vulnerable areas.

motivering: L's aid agenda prioritises 'democracy, gender equality, and reduced corruption', which in principle supports the C motions' aim of women's participation in post-conflict reconstruction. The committee rejects the motions with reference to ongoing multilateral work already covering this. As a governing party, with the assessment that existing efforts are sufficient, L votes with the committee.

citations.quote: Swedish aid policy must undergo major reforms with a focus on democracy, gender equality, and reduced corruption.

citations.quote: Gender equality must continue to advance.

motivering: Through the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement), the Liberals have committed to a comprehensive reform agenda for migration and integration. citations.quote: The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on matters covered by the directives to the cooperation projects.

citations.quote: Sweden shall wholeheartedly support Ukraine in ensuring that Russia's unprovoked war of aggression must end in a complete Russian military retreat. With Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine – this attack on all of Europe – the threat to our security order is acute.

citations.quote: we are in favour of real climate taxes instead of turning climate policy into a competition for the highest subsidies and the most symbolic taxes.
