citations.quote: Cultural policy shall be based on freedom, diversity and quality but shall not interfere in the content of culture. We therefore want the state to govern less and for it to be cultural creators — not politicians — who make decisions on support.
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the matters covered by the directives for the cooperation projects.

motivering: L is a governing party and the committee's proposal rejects C's, MP's and S's motions on developing the pre-school, citing ongoing work. L wants to make pre-school compulsory from the age of five and to expand it, but is implementing this through the Tidö agreement's school cooperation project and the government process, not through opposition motions.

citations.quote: make the universal pre-school compulsory from the age of five
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the matters covered by the directives for the cooperation projects.

motivering: The Tidö agreement (the Tidö agreement) prescribes an inquiry into prohibiting foreign financing of religious communities (trossamfund) linked to Islamism and extremism. The committee's rejection, citing ongoing inquiry work, is directly consistent with this. L supports the financing of civil society but wants to stop covert extremist financing, and votes Yes with the committee majority.

citations.quote: An inquiry shall review a prohibition on foreign financing of religious communities and other organisations in the civil society sphere with links to Islamism and extremism
We want both to strengthen the monitoring of grant-giving and to stop covert financing of religious communities so that they do not become tools for extremist forces.

Society is built from the bottom up — civil society is not a complement to but a prerequisite for democracy. We want to continue improving civil society's financing through both broader tax deductions for donations and long-term government grants.

motivering: L is a governing party and the committee's proposal rejects C's and SD's motions on debt relief and damages. The Tidö agreement states that the criminal injuries compensation (brottsskadeersättning) regulatory framework is being reviewed through the ordinary preparatory process; rejecting individual motions is consistent with the ongoing inquiry. L supports strengthened victims' rights but through the proper channel.

citations.quote: The regulatory framework for criminal injuries compensation is being reviewed with the aim of reducing the victim's responsibility to personally recover the full damages from the perpetrator.
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the matters covered by the directives for the cooperation projects.

motivering: The Liberals' election manifesto explicitly demands that costly construction subsidies be abolished; the phasing out of the investment support for rental housing in the proposal is directly in line with this commitment. Through the Tidö agreement, L commits to voting for the government's budget and to rejecting V's alternative motion to retain the support.

citations.quote: Today's costly construction subsidies shall be abolished and a new system of need-based housing shall be introduced for groups with particularly great housing needs, such as those subjected to violence and families with very weak finances.
The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.

motivering: The Liberals' cultural policy emphasises that the state should govern less and that cultural creators — not politicians — make decisions on support, which argues against a new, detailed-regulation arts school act (kulturskolelag). The committee refers to ongoing work, and L, as part of the governing majority, supports the committee's rejection of MP's motion.

citations.quote: Cultural policy shall be based on freedom, diversity and quality but shall not interfere in the content of culture. We therefore want the state to govern less and for it to be cultural creators — not politicians — who make decisions on support.
citations.princip: The state governs less in culture

motivering: The Liberals want to strengthen civil society financing and the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) initiates an inquiry into foreign financing of faith communities with Islamist ties. Reservation 1 (likely SD's line) deviates from the Tidöavtalet's inquiry framework. L supports the committee's rejection since the ongoing preparatory work covers the issues.

citations.quote: An inquiry shall review a ban on foreign financing of faith communities and other civil society organizations with connections to Islamism and extremism, and develop proposals for stricter regulations and oversight with regard to the financing of such organizations.
We want to continue improving civil society financing through both broader tax deductions for donations and long-term state grants.

motivering: The Liberals and the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) are investing in expanded charging infrastructure for electric vehicles. The committee rejects C's specific motions with reference to work already under way within this framework. As part of the government basis, L supports the committee's assessment that existing preparation is sufficient.

citations.quote: The charging infrastructure is being expanded.
Charging points are needed where we live, work and travel.

motivering: S's motion on the Global Deal — a global framework for decent working conditions — is social-democratic in character and runs counter to L's market-liberal labour market policy. L wants it to become simpler and cheaper to hire, not for more global regulatory frameworks to be concluded. As a governing party, L rejects the motion together with the committee. L votes Yes.

citations.quote: we want it to become simpler and cheaper to hire by lowering employer contributions for both small business owners and for those who want to hire young people.
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on issues that the directives for the cooperation projects cover.

motivering: The Liberals advocate real climate taxes rather than symbolic politics. The chemical tax's lack of effectiveness is documented in evaluations, and neither the election manifesto nor the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) contains a commitment to develop it further. The committee's rejection of the motion is consistent with the party's line of prioritising actual climate impact, and L follows the coalition's joint position.

citations.quote: That is why we support real climate taxes instead of turning climate policy into a competition for the highest subsidies and the most symbolic taxes.
citations.princip: real climate taxes, not symbolic politics

citations.quote: The polluter shall pay. It is the polluter — no one else — who shall pay.

motivering: C's motion on an emissions trading system for the Baltic Sea is in principle consistent with L's support for market-based climate instruments and the fight against eutrophication, but is not specifically proposed in L's documents. The committee refers to ongoing work. As a governing party and without an explicit policy position on this specific issue, L follows the committee's assessment.

citations.quote: The fight against eutrophication shall continue, industrial fishing shall be restricted, and the most valuable sea areas shall be protected as marine reserves.
citations.princip: protection of the Baltic Sea against eutrophication

citations.quote: A European carbon dioxide tax and climate tariffs are needed in order to raise the cost of emissions.

motivering: L's election manifesto supports strengthened assistance for people with disabilities, but via personal assistance allowance (assistansersättning) and LSS reform, not via expanded student aid. Changing student aid in cases of sick leave or disability lacks specific support in L's documents. The committee's rejection of V's and S's motions is consistent with L's position.

citations.quote: The shortcomings in today's personal assistance allowance (assistansersättning) — our most important support for many people with disabilities — are so serious that a crisis commission is required.
citations.princip: Disability support via personal assistance reform

motivering: The Liberals' documents do not specifically address children's formal influence and participation in cultural life. The committee refers to ongoing work and rejects S's motions; as part of the government basis L supports the committee's line. L's democratic principle that society's freedom is built from below rather than through political micromanagement supports the rejection.

citations.quote: Society is built from below — civil society is not a complement to but a prerequisite for democracy.

motivering: The Liberals' documents do not specifically take a position on SJ AB's ownership form or management. The motions from SD and V represent diverging lines that L has not committed to supporting. As a governing party, L votes Yes to the committee's rejection, in line with the ongoing state ownership policy.

citations.quote: We want to eliminate the railway network's bottlenecks so that trains run on time here and now, rather than spending hundreds of billions on a high-speed railway that will not be ready even in 20 years.

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) explicitly commits to raising the income threshold for labour migration, with the starting point that work permits should normally be granted for jobs at median wage level. The government's proposal for a raised maintenance requirement is a direct implementation of this commitment. As a governing party, the Liberals have committed to voting for the government's own bills within the framework of the cooperation project.

citations.quote: Investigative work shall be commissioned to review the regulatory framework for labour migration with the aim of raising the income threshold. The starting point shall be that work permits are only granted if the work for which labour migration occurs normally carries a wage level corresponding to the median wage.
citations.princip: raised income threshold for work permits

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget in its entirety is passed in the Riksdag.
citations.princip: vote with the government in the cooperation projects

motivering: The government has in its communication signalled that it intends to consider provisions against overpricing at pharmacies, which the committee endorses. The committee's rejection of the motion (item 1) is consistent with L's support for a step-by-step, state-led reform of pharmacy supervision. The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) emphasises effective state supervision and increased scrutiny of healthcare actors. L votes Yes.

citations.quote: IVO or the Authority for Health and Care Analysis should be given authority to also review regions' and municipalities' operations with regard to medical outcomes.

A broad review of healthcare organisation and financing is needed. The state shall take greater responsibility for the strategic planning of healthcare, the location of highly specialised care, preparedness and long-term competence supply.

motivering: The Liberals are part of the government basis and have committed to voting collectively with the coalition on budget-related matters. The committee's line of noting the PLO communication and rejecting V's motion is compatible with the principle of stable and transparent public finances. No documents provide support for V's reservation.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget in its entirety is passed in the Riksdag.
The budget agreement is built on the precondition that the budget framework remains in place and that the budget is decided in its entirety.

motivering: The question of state ownership and management of companies is not specifically covered in the Liberals' documents, but the party's market-economy orientation and government cooperation suggest supporting the committee's proposal to note the communication. Motions from SD, C and MP on alternative management directions are not supported by L's own commitments.

citations.quote: Corporate taxes and capital taxes shall be competitive and promote more new companies that contribute to jobs, growth and prosperity.
More entrepreneurs and business owners create more jobs and more prosperity.

motivering: The Swedish Inheritance Fund (Allmänna arvsfonden) finances projects for children, the elderly, and people with disabilities — precisely the civil society that the Liberals highlight as a prerequisite for democracy. The committee's assessment that the funds have been well distributed and that the written communication can be filed is compatible with L's strong prioritization of civil society funding and its role.

citations.quote: Society is built from below – civil society is not a complement to but a prerequisite for democracy.
We want to continue improving civil society's funding through both broader tax deductions for donations and long-term state grants.

motivering: The Liberals affirm that online doctors are here to stay and protect digital accessibility in healthcare. The Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) recommendation on national guidelines is already being handled by the National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen), and the government shares Riksrevisionen's conclusions. The committee's proposal to file the written communication is compatible with the party's support for digital healthcare and the ongoing preparatory work; SD's reservation demands additional measures beyond what the coalition parties have agreed upon.

citations.quote: The online doctor is here to stay. We want to see a digital freedom-of-choice reform and healthcare guarantee where all regions are required to offer at least as good digital accessibility as physical, where you based on your situation can always choose how you want to access healthcare.

The doctor's role in the care chain is clarified
Measures are taken to counteract incorrect prescription of medication, for example by abolishing the right to prescribe for doctors who have not worked clinically in the profession for an extended period.
citations.princip: the doctor's role and quality assurance

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) prescribes that the waste incineration tax is to be reviewed in order to create better conditions for combined heat and power — the coalition signals a reduction or abolition, not upward GDP indexation. The committee's rejection of the bill's GDP indexation is directly compatible with this commitment. The Liberals vote Yes.

citations.quote: The combined heat and power tax, the waste incineration tax, and the tax on bio-oil are reviewed in order to create better conditions for combined heat and power.

The polluter must pay. It is the polluter – no one else – who must pay. That is why we support genuine climate taxes instead of turning climate policy into a competition for the highest subsidies and the most symbolic taxes.

motivering: The Liberals' election manifesto explicitly demands a defence appropriation of 2 percent of GDP as early as 2025 and a substantially strengthened military defence. The committee's rejection of opposition parties' (C, SD and S) motions on defence policy is compatible with the line represented by the Liberals' own commitments. No documents support endorsing any of the current reservations.

citations.quote: We therefore want to see a defence appropriation of 2 percent of GDP as early as 2025 and thereby create sufficient conditions to strengthen both the army, the navy, and the air force.
Sweden needs a significantly stronger military defence than today.

Today, security is created in alliances, not in non-alignment. Therefore Sweden should join NATO and together with the USA, Canada and our European neighbours defend both Sweden and our part of the world.

motivering: The committee's proposal rejects the Left Party's (Vänsterpartiet) claim 3 on increased resources. The Liberals and the Tidö agreement advocate a performance-based, nationally coordinated resource allocation – state funds are, as a general rule, to be performance-based with clear follow-up, not distributed in the disconnected manner that V likely advocates in Reservation 4.

citations.quote: The starting point shall be that state funds are, as a general rule, performance-based with clear follow-up.
The state shall take greater responsibility for the strategic planning of healthcare, the location of highly specialised care, preparedness, and long-term competence supply.

motivering: L's election manifesto advocates the work-first principle (arbetslinjen) and that it should pay off to work, but contains no specific position on the earnings allowance (fribeloppet) within student financial aid. The opposition motions on the earnings allowance lack explicit grounding in L's reform programme. As a governing party, L votes with the committee majority's rejection.

citations.quote: Sweden is still one of the countries in the world with the highest taxes on labour. This means that work and effort here pay off less – and sometimes not at all.
More profitable to move from benefits to work, to get an education, and to take on greater responsibility at work.
citations.princip: Work and studies should pay off

motivering: The confidentiality rule for electricity users' personal circumstances when processing electricity support is a privacy-protection measure that enables households to apply for the support without personal data being disclosed. It is part of the implementation of the electricity support that the Liberals and the Tidö agreement explicitly advocate in order to quickly relieve affected households and businesses. L's own government has submitted the bill.

citations.quote: A high-cost protection for affected households and businesses as soon as practically possible – with retroactive payment.
We want to both lower the VAT on electricity and the special additional tax on electricity in order to mitigate the electricity price shock here and now
citations.princip: mitigate the electricity price shock immediately

motivering: The Liberals' programme supports equal conditions across the country and the state's responsibility for services and public authorities in rural areas. The committee's decision to file the Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) written communication on regional policy and to reject opposition proposals (C, S, V) is compatible with giving priority to ongoing reform work within the coalition. Nothing in the documents supports a reservation.

citations.quote: The road network shall function and state authorities shall be present in all parts of Sweden.

We want to create more equal conditions and taxation by transferring the funding responsibility for, among other things, schools and LSS (the Act concerning Support and Service for Persons with Certain Functional Impairments) to the state.

motivering: The Tidö agreement obliges L to reform the Settlement Act (bosättningslagen) with increased municipal influence – work that is ongoing within the framework of the government coalition. The committee's rejection of opposition motions (MP, C, S) refers to ongoing investigative work, which is consistent with L's Tidö agreement commitment. L votes Yes.

citations.quote: The Settlement Act/Assignment Act (bosättningslagen/anvisningslagen) should be reviewed with regard to the weighting of the factors that govern the distribution of newly arrived immigrants, and the housing situation in a municipality should constitute an additional factor. The Act should in the long run be abolished and replaced with a model with greater municipal influence.
citations.princip: The Settlement Act is to be reformed

motivering: A clearer and more independent central bank strengthens democratic institutions and the rule of law in economic governance, in line with L's demand for strengthened and independent state institutions. Rejecting V's motions and adopting the new Riksbank Act (riksbankslagen) with a clarified mandate and strengthened independence is consistent with L's institutional policy.

citations.quote: We want to see strengthened constitutional protection for our democratic system of government, increase the independence of the courts, and work for a constitutional court that can strike down laws or provisions that contravene constitutionally protected rights and freedoms.
Swedish democracy shall stand strong and your rights shall be defended.

motivering: The Liberals want a market-liberal housing policy with freely negotiated tenancy agreements and simpler building regulations. A pre-emption act (förköpslag) entails extended municipal regulation of the property market, which is contrary to L's line of avoiding state interventions that hamper the market. L supports the committee's rejection of V's and S's motions.

citations.quote: In order to increase the construction of more rental apartments and shorten the queues, we want to combine strong security of tenure with the rent in newly built rental apartments being freely negotiated between landlord and tenant. Today's expensive construction subsidies shall be abolished

motivering: Rules on gambling advertising are not covered by L's documents. The committee proposes that V's motion on stricter requirements for moderation in the marketing of gambling be rejected, in line with the coalition majority's position. L has no stated position on the matter and follows the coalition line.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties the Sweden Democrats, the Moderates, the Christian Democrats, and the Liberals are agreed on taking responsibility for Sweden in a joint cooperation during the parliamentary term 2022–2026.

motivering: The Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) review reveals deficient supervision of pharmacies and the pharmaceuticals trade, which threatens patient safety. M's Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) establishes that 'the patient's best interests shall be at the centre of the reform work' and the government welcomes the review. The Committee on Health and Welfare (Socialutskottet) notes the communication and rejects the motions from V and C. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: The patient's best interests shall be at the centre of the reform work.

motivering: The Moderates want a more efficient rental market with more market-adjusted rent-setting. An independent dispute-resolution body for collective rent negotiations streamlines the process and aligns with M's goal of a well-functioning housing market. V's motion (Malcolm Momodou Jallow et al., points 1–2) is rejected.

citations.quote: Enable fairer rents by giving prospective tenants' valuation of the dwelling greater weight
A well-functioning housing market is a prerequisite for increased growth.

motivering: In their election manifesto, the Moderates have explicitly pledged to upgrade the existing railway instead of investing in high-speed trains. The committee's proposal rejects motions aimed at investments in new infrastructure that do not align with the government line's priorities, and includes a tillkännagivande (formal request to the government) not to build high-speed rail. M's own commitments are directly in line with the committee's position.

citations.quote: Upgrade today's railway instead of investing in high-speed trains that risk becoming outdated before they are even completed

motivering: The Moderates actively seek to 'Develop cyber defence' and are part of the government whose work the Committee on Defence (försvarsutskottet) identifies as ongoing. The motions from C, SD and S reflect positions that do not fit within the coalition's governance. The committee's rejection is consistent with M's role as a governing party driving cyber issues within the existing structure. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Develop cyber defence
Strengthen defence intelligence capability

motivering: M's clear goal of defence appropriations amounting to 2 per cent of GDP by 2025 at the latest, and strengthened military capability, gives strong support for the committee's proposal of SEK 94 billion in appropriations and SEK 173 billion in procurement authorisations for 2024–2031. The reservations from C and SD lack support in M's own documents; the party's position is to strengthen total defence in line with the government's investment.

citations.quote: Work to ensure that defence appropriations amount to the equivalent of 2 per cent of GDP as early as 2025
Strengthen the army, the air force and the navy in terms of both capability and equipment

motivering: The Moderates have no specific position on the prohibition on enforcement (utmätningsförbudet). M's overarching line on order and responsibility in the economy provides no support for SD's reservation. As a governing party behind the committee's proposal and with no divergent policy, M votes with the committee for rejection.

citations.quote: In tough economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required

motivering: M supports well-organised pension saving and the finances of pensioners. The government's proposal on AP7's objectives and expanded investment opportunities in illiquid assets strengthens the default option for those who have not actively chosen pension funds. V's motion (Alternative A) is likely incompatible with M's market-friendly view on pension management, which is why a Yes vote is given.

citations.quote: We uphold the work principle in the pension system – it shall always be more rewarding to have worked than not to have done so.
citations.princip: the work principle in the pension system

citations.quote: Develop proposals on how pensioners' finances can be strengthened and freedom of choice protected.
citations.princip: strengthened pensioner finances and freedom of choice

motivering: The Moderates and the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) advocate a requirements-based integration policy with mandatory civic orientation (samhällsorientering) conditioned on benefits, the work principle, and self-sufficiency. C's and MP's motions on the settlement law (bosättningslagen) and the establishment of newly arrived women deviate from M's reform direction. The committee rejects the motions with reference to ongoing investigative work within the framework of the Tidöavtalet.

citations.quote: To introduce a requirements-based integration policy, whereby those who have been living in Sweden for an extended period shall take responsibility for becoming part of Swedish society.

propose legislative amendments that make civic introduction and civic orientation mandatory and conditional in such a way that daily allowance from the Swedish Migration Agency, social assistance, establishment allowance or other public support or benefits requires participation
citations.princip: mandatory civic orientation conditioned on benefits

citations.quote: Require basic knowledge of Swedish for permanent residence permits and citizenship

motivering: The Committee on Labour Market (Arbetsmarknadsutskottet) rejects V's and MP's claims regarding employment rate and employment law. M's labour market policy aims to make it 'more rewarding to move from benefits to work' and combats passive long-term unemployment, rather than extending employment protection in the direction sought by V and MP. M supports the committee's rejection and votes Yes.

citations.quote: A major benefit reform is implemented that makes it more rewarding to move from benefits to work and self-sufficiency.
Break passive long-term unemployment through clear requirements and opportunities to carry out measures that lead to employment.

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) commits M to developing constitutional amendments to enable the criminalisation of participation in criminal organisations. The dormant proposal on an expanded possibility to restrict freedom of association for terrorist associations is the constitutional foundation needed. The election manifesto's pledge to 'prohibit participation in organisations engaged in violence-affirming activities' confirms a Yes vote.

citations.quote: Proposals for constitutional amendments are developed to enable criminalisation of participation in, and association with, criminal organisations.
Prohibit participation in organisations with violence-affirming activities and prohibit participation in criminal gangs

motivering: M wants to reform development aid to focus on results, and prioritises democracy and human rights. The committee rejects C's motions on women's participation in reconstruction with reference to ongoing work. M's reformed aid framework already covers these priorities, which is why M supports the committee's rejection. Vote: Yes.

citations.quote: Prioritise measures that support the work for democracy and human rights
citations.princip: Democracy and human rights in development aid

citations.quote: Focus Swedish development aid on the countries, organisations and thematic areas where it does the most good

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) establishes that the establishment allowance (etableringsersättningen) shall be lower than other benefits and that full-time activity is required for full compensation — a requirements-based line that conflicts with the motions from V, MP and S on the target group of the establishment programme. The election manifesto confirms that newly arrived immigrants shall qualify for welfare benefits through work. M, as a governing party, supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: The establishment allowance shall be reviewed/reformed. The establishment allowance shall be lower than the public support and benefits that may be applicable to persons who have lived in Sweden for a long time, which is why the establishment supplement and the right to supplementary social assistance should be abolished for those who receive the establishment allowance.
citations.princip: Reduced establishment allowance with activity requirements

citations.quote: Ensure that those who have immigrated qualify for various welfare benefits through work and education

motivering: Gambling regulation (spelreglering) is not specifically addressed in M's election manifesto or the Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet). The committee — under the leadership of the new coalition majority — proposes rejecting SD's motion 2. In the absence of M's own documented positions, M follows the committee's overall assessment, which likely reflects the new government's direction toward an orderly and market-based regulated gambling offering.

citations.quote: The Moderates want to build a country where a free business sector creates prosperity that benefits everyone.
Strengthen the incentives for investment, research and entrepreneurship through lower taxes on business

motivering: The Moderates lack specific positions on special transport services (färdtjänst) or the current public transport questions. M emphasises good infrastructure for jobs and growth throughout the country. As a governing party, M supports the committee's rejection of the motions.

citations.quote: High-quality infrastructure is important for jobs and growth in all parts of the country

motivering: The committee's proposal approves the essential parts of the bill on foreign espionage and secret coercive measures, with a technical adjustment to Chapter 27, Section 2 of the Code of Judicial Procedure (RB 27 kap. 2 §). The Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) requires that secret coercive measures be implemented, and the election manifesto's promise to strengthen the Security Police (Säkerhetspolisen) points toward M supporting the overall security package. A Yes vote is cast in consideration of the committee's modified version.

citations.quote: The possibilities to use secret coercive measures in law enforcement are to be implemented. The proposals in SOU 2022:19 shall form the basis for legislation and the effects shall be evaluated to determine whether further tightening is necessary during the term of office.
Strengthen the Security Police (Säkerhetspolisen) to increase their capacity to protect liberal democracy and all citizens of the country

motivering: Chemical policy is not part of the Tidö Agreement's (Tidöavtalet) cooperation projects and M's election manifesto lacks specific commitments regarding new chemical investigations. M wants to minimise red tape and keep EU directives at the minimum level rather than gold-plating them. The committee rejects SD's motions citing sufficient ongoing work. M supports the rejection.

citations.quote: Reduce red tape and unnecessary bureaucracy, including by counteracting over-implementation in Sweden of EU decisions — as a general rule, EU directives shall be implemented at the minimum level
citations.princip: No EU over-implementation in chemicals policy

citations.quote: Remove one third of companies' administrative costs and one third of the regulatory burden

motivering: The Moderates actively moved — through Camilla Waltersson Grönvall et al. (M, SD, KD, L) — to reject the government's provision on private care providers' contracts with regions when they also have insurance companies as principals. The Tidö Agreement's (Tidöavtalet) healthcare project requires that reforms reduce the administrative burden and unnecessary bureaucracy. The requirement that contracts regulate insurance company relationships entails increased administration without a clear benefit. The committee's proposal directly reflects M's own motion requests.

citations.quote: The proposals in the project shall aim to reduce the administrative burden and unnecessary bureaucracy
Remove one third of companies' administrative costs and one third of the regulatory burden

motivering: The Moderates advocate cost-effective, technology-neutral climate measures and a market-oriented approach. The Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) prescribes that climate policy shall seek the most cost-effective measures without harming business. A specific investment prohibition for AP funds (the national pension funds) against fossil-lobbying companies goes further than M's market-based approach and lacks direct support in M's documents. The committee's rejection of the motion is consistent with M's position.

citations.quote: Our shared climate and environment policy is grounded in the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most cost-effective measures, which at the same time do not harm industries and rural areas
Change the energy policy target from 100 per cent renewable to 100 per cent fossil-free

motivering: The Committee on Labour Market Affairs rejects C's motions on EU labour market legislation (fixed-term employment, agency work, posting of workers). The Moderates are a governing party and the Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) stipulates that the cooperation parties shall not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on issues covered by the projects, which includes labour market matters. M supports the committee's position.

citations.quote: The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the issues covered by the mandates for the cooperation projects.
citations.princip: no unilateral cooperation with other parties

citations.quote: Lower administrative costs for businesses.

motivering: The Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) stipulates that work permits shall require a salary at the median wage level — a direct support for the government's proposal on a raised maintenance requirement (försörjningskrav) for labour immigrants. The aim is to strengthen their position in the labour market and counteract competition through low wages, in line with M's work-first (arbetslinjen) principle. A Yes vote entails rejection of V's motion (item 1) and support for the government's legislative proposal.

citations.quote: The starting point shall be that work permits are only to be granted if the work for which labour immigration occurs normally has a wage level corresponding to the median wage.
citations.princip: tightened wage conditions for work permits

citations.quote: Ensure that those who have immigrated qualify for various welfare benefits through work and education

motivering: The Moderates have in their election manifesto demanded personal appearance to confirm coordination numbers (samordningsnummer) and the Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) stipulates that unconfirmed numbers shall be revoked. The government's proposal strengthens the system with tiered identity controls and the Swedish Tax Agency's (Skatteverket) responsibility — which mirrors M's own commitments. Voting Yes entails rejection of V's item 2, which works against this position.

citations.quote: Require personal appearance to confirm coordination numbers (samordningsnummer), otherwise they shall be revoked
Coordination numbers that are not confirmed in a satisfactory manner by the holder shall in due course be revoked.

motivering: The Moderates advocate implementing EU directives at the minimum level and deepening the digital single market. The government's proposal implements the DSM Directive into Swedish law in accordance with EU requirements to modernise copyright for the digital environment. The alternative item 3 (reservation 4) on choice-of-law rules lacks support in M's documents.

citations.quote: as a general rule, EU directives shall be implemented at the minimum level
Deepen the single market, not least for services and digital products

motivering: M's documents do not specifically address distraint (utmätning) in cases of inadequate credit assessment. The Left Party's proposal does not fit within M's market-oriented view of the economy and business sector. As a governing party behind the committee's position, M votes to reject V's motion.

citations.quote: Sweden's prosperity is built on a dynamic and vibrant business sector

motivering: M's Tidö Agreement (Tidöavtalet) sets as a central goal that 'more crimes are investigated and lead to prosecution'. Faster prosecution of crimes is M's own government bill and directly fulfils this goal. The election manifesto's promise to invest in more prosecutors underlines M's ambition for an effective justice system, which is why C's opposition motion should be rejected.

citations.quote: that more crimes are investigated and lead to prosecution, that serious organised crime is combated, that victims of crime receive greater redress and that sentences become more just.
Invest in more prosecutors so that more crimes can lead to a conviction

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) specifies that national plans to eliminate the shortage of hospital beds and cut waiting queues are to be developed through the government's own bills (propositioner). Previous opposition motions (incl. M's motions 4 and 9) are now superseded by the government's own programme. The committee's decision to file the matter (lägga till handlingarna) is standard procedure when the party is in government, and M votes Yes.

citations.quote: A national long-term plan to eliminate the shortage of hospital beds shall
citations.princip: national plan against shortage of hospital beds

citations.quote: Establish a national healthcare brokerage service (vårdförmedling) that shall help patients with long waiting times to receive care in another part of the country where there is available capacity
citations.princip: national healthcare brokerage service against waiting queues

motivering: The Tidö agreement obliges M to support the entire budget including expenditure area 2. V's motion on Agenda 2030 is rejected by the committee; M prioritises efficient public administration and stopping the waste of taxpayers' money rather than tying the budget to external target frameworks. The committee's proposal is in line with M's position.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget is passed in its entirety in the Riksdag.
State expenditure shall decrease – we shall stop the waste of taxpayers' money

motivering: M's manifesto contains nothing specific about the distinctive character of the non-profit associational sector (ideellt föreningsliv). M safeguards religious communities (trossamfund) and civil society's freedom in democracy, but the specific motions from C and S are not linked to M's own priorities. As a governing party, M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: Safeguard the security of religious communities so that everyone can practise their faith without feeling threatened
citations.princip: Protection of religious communities and civil society

motivering: The Moderates (Moderaterna) safeguard media plurality and transparency as a cornerstone of the democratic infrastructure. Increased transparency in the ownership of radio and television companies strengthens openness in the media landscape and is consistent with M's principles of free and independent media. The committee's proposal approves the government's legislative amendment and rejects the motion.

citations.quote: A plurality of free and independent media that maintain high quality plays an absolutely decisive role in the open and democratic society.
The freedom of the media shall be safeguarded, and the plurality of different media shall be promoted.
citations.princip: media freedom in the Tidö agreement

motivering: M wants defence appropriations to reach 2% of GDP by 2025 and for the capability of the army, air force and navy to be strengthened. The fact that the committee rejects all motions – including M's own motion (Wallmark) – citing ongoing work is standard procedure: the government pursues defence policy through bills (propositioner), not through time-limited motions. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Work towards defence appropriations reaching the equivalent of 2 per cent of GDP as early as 2025
Strengthen the army, air force and navy with regard to both capability and materiel

motivering: The Moderates require that those whose asylum application has been rejected leave Sweden as quickly as possible — which presupposes efficient court processes. The government's written communication (skrivelse) concurs with the Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) criticism of inefficiency and commits to follow-up. The committee's proposal to reject V's and MP's motions and to file the written communication is consistent with M's migration policy line.

citations.quote: It is of the utmost importance that those who have received a refusal on their asylum application leave the country as quickly as possible.
Procedural measures that are possible to accelerate border and transit procedures shall be implemented if Swedish law is more favourable to the applicant than what follows from EU law.

motivering: M's documents do not specifically address the agency structure in the transport sector. M wants efficient infrastructure planning and good public administration. The committee rejects SD's motion and M votes in line with the committee as a governing party.

citations.quote: High-quality infrastructure is important for jobs and growth in all parts of the country

motivering: The Tidö agreement explicitly commits to revising the statute of limitations provisions and abolishing the statute of limitations for sexual offences against children. The committee rejects C's and S's motions on the statute of limitations, citing precisely this ongoing preparatory work. M's own Tidö agreement commitments fully cover the issues, which is why M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: The statute of limitations provisions shall be revised
citations.princip: Revision of statute of limitations rules in the Tidö agreement

citations.quote: the statute of limitations shall be abolished for all forms of sexual offences against children under 18 years of age
citations.princip: Abolition of the statute of limitations for sexual offences against children

motivering: The criminalisation of foreign espionage in the Penal Code (brottsbalken) and the adjustments to intelligence legislation strengthen the state's ability to protect classified information. M's commitment to 'strengthen the Swedish Security Service (Säkerhetspolisen)' and the Tidö agreement's requirement that covert coercive measures be implemented in accordance with SOU 2022:19 point directly towards a Yes vote on this legislative package.

citations.quote: Strengthen the Swedish Security Service (Säkerhetspolisen) to increase their ability to protect the liberal democracy and all the country's citizens

The possibilities to use covert coercive measures in law enforcement shall be implemented. The proposals in SOU 2022:19 shall form the basis for legislation and the effects shall be evaluated with a view to determining whether further tightening measures are necessary during the term of office.
citations.princip: covert coercive measures and intelligence legislation

motivering: M's fundamental EU policy principle is that decisions should be taken at the lowest possible level and that the EU should not decide on everything. The committee's subsidiarity objection (subsidiaritetsinvändning) against the European Commission's crisis instrument – specifically regarding the provisions on goods and services of strategic importance – is consistent with M's line of countering EU over-implementation. M supports the reasoned opinion (motiverade yttrandet).

citations.quote: The EU shall neither do nor make decisions on everything. Decisions shall be taken at the lowest possible level, as close to the citizens as possible.
Reduce regulatory burden and unnecessary bureaucracy, including by countering over-implementation in Sweden of EU decisions – as a general rule, EU directives shall be implemented at minimum level

motivering: The Moderates support Baltic Sea work and measures against eutrophication but consider that EU directives should be implemented at minimum level without over-implementation. The committee is already proposing a positive formal request (tillkännagivande) on wetlands. SD's separate motion demands regarding the Water Framework Directive add nothing beyond ongoing work and M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: Strengthen the joint Baltic Sea work on measures against eutrophication and littering
citations.princip: Baltic Sea work is ongoing through other procedures

citations.quote: Reduce regulatory burden and unnecessary bureaucracy, including by countering over-implementation in Sweden of EU decisions – as a general rule, EU directives shall be implemented at minimum level

motivering: The Moderates want to stop benefits fraud and population registration (folkbokföring) offences, and the Tidö agreement stipulates that government agencies shall be required to report suspected population registration fraud. The notification obligation (underrättelseskyldighet) of the coordination number (samordningsnummer) reform is the core of this work. V's motion demand 4 on exemptions from the obligation counteracts the purpose of the reform, which is why M's line is to vote Yes and reject V's motion.

citations.quote: Government agencies shall be required to report suspected population registration fraud.
citations.princip: notification obligation against population registration fraud

citations.quote: Carry out a national census to stop benefits offences

motivering: Motions on the redistribution of production values from natural resources (V, MP, S) entail new redistributive charges on resource extraction. M maintains that mineral assets should be able to be extracted without increased burdens and that corporate taxes should be competitive. The committee's rejection reflects the coalition's market-oriented line and M's property-rights principles. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Our rich mineral assets must be able to be extracted responsibly and in a long-term sustainable manner
Corporate taxes and capital taxes must be competitive and promote more new companies that contribute to jobs, growth, and prosperity.

motivering: World Heritage issues and cultural heritage conservation are not a specifically prioritized area in the Moderates' documents or the Tidö Agreement (the Tidö agreement). As a governing party, M supports the committee's rejection, citing that existing efforts and ongoing work are sufficient. The reform agenda prioritizes security, the economy, and defense over new cultural heritage legislation.

citations.quote: We know what must be done – and what can wait.
The major needs in the justice system, defense, and welfare place great demands on priorities in the years to come.

motivering: M has committed in its election manifesto to writing off student loans specifically for police officers — a promise pursued through its own government bills rather than through SD's motion on loan write-offs for professional groups in general. As a governing party, M supports the committee's rejection and pursues its police reform through the proper legislative process.

citations.quote: Write off the student loans of those who train and begin working as police officers
citations.princip: Student loan write-off for police officers

citations.quote: We know what must be done – and what can wait.

motivering: The Moderates are part of the Tidö Agreement (the Tidö agreement) cooperation and are bound not to unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on criminal law matters covered by the cooperation project on Crime. The committee's proposal to reject the motions — citing ongoing investigation and preparatory work — reflects the governing coalition's unified reform approach. A V motion on incitement against a group of people falls outside M's own reform program and cannot be supported by a party that has committed to implementing criminal justice reform through the joint process.

citations.quote: The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the matters covered by the terms of reference for the cooperation projects.
citations.princip: not unilaterally cooperating with other parties

citations.quote: The purpose of the project is to develop and implement concrete policy proposals that solve Sweden's most important social problems related to crime and gang criminality.
citations.princip: unified crime reform through the project

motivering: The Moderates want to significantly reduce red tape and administrative burdens for businesses. The committee rejects motions from SD and MP on mandatory requirements for the composition of company boards. M's deregulatory line means that mandatory quota rules are not prioritized, and the committee's rejection is consistent with this principle.

citations.quote: Remove one third of companies' administrative costs and one third of the red tape
citations.princip: Reduce regulation and red tape for businesses

motivering: The Tidö Agreement (the Tidö agreement) establishes that the conditions for working professionals to pursue further education should be improved and that higher education institutions' transition mandate should be strengthened, but this reform work is pursued through its own channels. The opposition's motions from V and S on student funding for transition are not M's instrument — M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: Improve the conditions for working professionals to pursue further education at colleges and universities. Strengthen higher education institutions' transition mandate.

The transition support, which follows from the parties' agreement, shall be managed in such a way that it is used for training programs with high demand in the labor market, thereby countering skills shortages and strengthening the competitiveness of the business sector.

motivering: M lacks specific positions on equality in public transport. The committee rejects C's and S's motions on gender-equal and equitable public transport, citing ongoing initiatives. As a governing party, M follows the committee's line.

citations.quote: High-quality infrastructure is important for jobs and growth in all parts of the country

motivering: The Moderates and the Tidö Agreement (the Tidö agreement) support expanded collection and storage of biometric data to strengthen identity checks and counter identity fraud. C's claim 2 (reservation 5) on the storage of biometric data aims to limit this part of the coordination number reform, which conflicts with M's line on strengthened biometric verification. A Yes vote means rejection of the C motion.

citations.quote: biometric data such as DNA data on third-country nationals applying for residence permits in Sweden shall be collected and stored in searchable registers to a greater extent than today
Require personal appearance to confirm a coordination number, otherwise it shall be revoked

motivering: The Moderates take no explicit position on Visit Sweden AB in their documents. However, in tough economic times, M demands order in the economy and that the surplus target be protected. The committee's rejection of C's claim regarding Visit Sweden AB follows the coalition's line that the conditions for state-owned companies are assessed in the ordinary budget process. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: In tough economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required. The surplus target must be protected, and transitioning to a balanced target is not on the agenda.

motivering: The Moderates are in principle opposed to property tax and want to 'stop the reintroduction of the property tax.' Motions on the regionalization of property tax — regardless of form — constitute a variant of this tax that M rejects. The committee's rejection of SD's and C's motions is consistent with M's clear tax line. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Stop the reintroduction of the property tax and reduced interest deductions
Stop the left from reintroducing the property tax

motivering: The Tidö Agreement (the Tidö agreement) obliges M to support the entire budget. The new target for foreign trade, export and investment promotion, and the appropriations for research and innovation within expenditure area 24 (UO24) reflect M's ambition to strengthen investment incentives, research, and Swedish competitiveness. S's motions are rejected.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget is voted through in its entirety in the Riksdag.
Strengthen the incentives for investment, research, and entrepreneurship through lower taxes on business
Deepen the internal market, not least for services and digital products

motivering: The election manifesto unequivocally states that M wants to 'Upgrade the existing railway instead of investing in high-speed trains that risk becoming outdated before they are even completed.' The committee's tillkännagivande (formal request) against building high-speed rail is identical to this party position. M votes Yes on the committee's overall proposal.

citations.quote: Upgrade today's railway instead of investing in high-speed trains that risk becoming outdated before they are completed
High-quality infrastructure is important for jobs and growth in all parts of the country

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) commits M to taking measures for children's leisure activities, including through a leisure card (fritidskort). The committee notes that work is already under way, which aligns with the M government implementing its own measures in this area. M votes Yes on the committee's proposal to reject the opposition motions.

citations.quote: Measures to reduce children's vulnerability shall be developed, including by protecting children's leisure activities through the introduction of a leisure card.

motivering: The Moderates strongly protect property rights but do not explicitly cover the level of expropriation compensation. As a governing party, M supports the committee's assessment that relevant work is under way and that the motions from SD and C can be rejected. M votes Yes in line with the governing coalition's basis.

citations.quote: Property rights are a prerequisite for sustainable forestry
Strengthen the right of ownership and right of use for farmers

motivering: M is a newly governing party and implements its policy through the Tidö agreement and the budget process rather than through opposition motions. Placing the previous S government's Agenda 2030 communication on file and rejecting all motions is a standard procedural decision. M's priorities regarding reformed and focused aid are being implemented as active government policy.

citations.quote: Abolish the one-percent target and replace it with a four-year budget framework for aid that creates predictability and a focus on results
citations.princip: reformed aid without a percentage target

citations.quote: Focus Swedish aid on the countries, organisations, and thematic areas where it does the most good

motivering: Museum issues and cultural heritage institutions are not specifically mentioned in the Moderates' manifesto or the Tidö agreement. As a governing party, M supports the committee's assessment that existing structures and ongoing work are sufficient to address the matters raised in the motions. New governance arrangements or an expanded mandate in museum affairs is not an M priority at this time.

citations.quote: We know what must be done — and what can wait.
The great needs within the justice system, defence, and welfare place heavy demands on prioritisation in the years ahead.

motivering: The government's bill closes a loophole that has allowed legal persons to acquire agricultural properties without an acquisition permit. M wants to 'strengthen the right of ownership and right of use for farmers' and to maintain the balance in land holdings between natural persons and legal persons. The legislative amendment is directly compatible with this goal. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Strengthen the right of ownership and right of use for farmers
Strengthen forest owners' property rights by ensuring that formal protection of forests takes place through voluntary means

motivering: The Tidö agreement gives M its own programme against segregation with a statutory basis for cooperation with property owners in vulnerable residential areas — a different approach from the motions put forward by S and MP. The electoral manifesto emphasises that integration capacity should be the governing factor, not expanded measures on the opposition's terms. M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: statutory support shall be developed for forms of cooperation with joint and mandatory responsibility between the public sector and all property owners to conduct long-term improvement work in 46 residential areas.
citations.princip: Own segregation programme with BID model

citations.quote: Our integration capacity shall be the governing factor for the level of immigration.

motivering: The Moderates uphold the work-first principle (arbetslinjen) in the pension system and reject motions that weaken the link between work and pension. The committee rejects all motions on changes to pension rules (V, MP, C, SD). M supports the committee's line in accordance with the Tidö agreement's cooperation commitments and the principle that pension reforms are handled within the joint growth project.

citations.quote: We uphold the work-first principle in the pension system — it should always pay off more to have worked than not to have done so.
citations.princip: the work-first principle in the pension system

citations.quote: The cooperation also entails that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on matters covered by the directives for the cooperation projects.

motivering: The Tidö agreement obliges M to support the entire budget, including expenditure area 10. The extension of the temporary exemption for sickness benefit assessment in cases of deferred care is a technical adjustment within the framework of responsible welfare policy. The committee's rejection of V's reservation (Alternative A) is consistent with M's position.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.
Restoring the work-first principle is the best way to ensure that Sweden's households have the strength to get through the difficult times that lie ahead.

motivering: The Moderates want to shorten government agencies' processing times, including those of the Land Survey Authority (Lantmäteriet). The committee rejects all motions, including M's own (Malin Höglund et al.), with reference to ongoing work. As a governing party, M accepts that the matters are handled in the ordinary manner through the government's own work and votes Yes.

citations.quote: Shorten government agencies' processing times by introducing a maximum time limit

motivering: The Moderates support high-quality infrastructure but place the emphasis on road and railway maintenance rather than expanded public transport. The committee rejects 37 opposition motions on public transport with reference to ongoing work, consistent with M's government programme. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: High-quality infrastructure is important for jobs and growth in all parts of the country
Repair Sweden's roads so that you can travel safely and on time

motivering: The Committee on Social Insurance rejects SD's and C's claims regarding reduction of social contributions. M wants competitive corporate taxes and lower employment costs but pursues these matters within the Tidö agreement's framework for growth and household economics, not through opposition motions. M supports the committee's rejection and votes Yes.

citations.quote: Corporate taxes and capital taxes shall be competitive and promote more new companies that contribute to jobs, growth, and prosperity.

motivering: The requirement for cash registers for amusement games is a tax compliance measure that counteracts undeclared work and increases transparency in gaming operators' revenue reporting. This aligns with M's general position on stopping the misuse of tax funds. The committee's proposal approves the legislative amendment to the Tax Procedures Act (skatteförfarandelagen) and rejects C's motion.

citations.quote: Every year, around 20 billion kronor that should have gone to welfare instead ends up in the pockets of benefit fraudsters and criminals.
citations.princip: stop tax fraud and benefit fraud

citations.quote: The Benefits Fraud Act shall be tightened and also cover support to businesses.

motivering: The government (M is the leading coalition party) proposes a raised VAT on repairs for greater tax uniformity. The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) obliges the cooperation parties to vote for the government's budget in its entirety. M supports the bill and the Finance Committee's proposal.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
In tough economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required. The surplus target shall be safeguarded
citations.princip: order and discipline in public finances

motivering: The Swedish National Audit Office (Riksrevisionen) notes deficiencies in pharmacy oversight. The government welcomes the review and the Committee on Health and Welfare accepts the written communication but rejects the current opposition motion on sanction fees. M supports the committee's position: oversight matters and the role of pharmacies are handled within the framework of the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) healthcare reforms.

citations.quote: The state takes full responsibility for the governance and follow-up of public funds for healthcare.
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally collaborate with other parties in the Riksdag on matters covered by the directives of the cooperation projects.

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) contains an explicit cooperation project for health and medical care with the goal of cutting waiting lists and improving accessibility. The committee finds the tillkännagivande (formal request) fully addressed, with express reference to the Tidöavtalet and the 2023 budget. M's Yes confirms that the party's own government has fulfilled the Riksdag's call.

citations.quote: The healthcare queues need to be cut, accessibility improved, and equality between different parts of the country needs to be ensured.
Expand the queue billion (kömiljarden) by directing special performance-based resources to the queues in cancer care and in child and adolescent psychiatry (BUP)

motivering: M's election manifesto contains direct commitments to strengthening Baltic Sea efforts against eutrophication and investing in water purification. The committee's tillkännagivande (formal request) on creating and restoring wetlands contributes directly to biodiversity and reduced eutrophication in seas and lakes — in line with the party's own environmental commitments. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Strengthen the joint Baltic Sea effort to combat eutrophication and littering
Invest in research on water purification and the expansion of advanced water purification

motivering: The Moderates support implementing EU directives at the minimum level and deepening the digital internal market. The government's proposal implements the DSM directive in accordance with EU law. V's requests 2–5 (reservation 5) on an alternative implementation of the directive lack support in M's documents. Yes means rejection of the V motion and support for the EU-compliant legislative proposal.

citations.quote: as a general rule, EU directives shall be implemented at the minimum level
Deepen the internal market, not least for services and digital products

motivering: M emphasises that civil defence is the foundation of the military: 'If the civil defence does not work, then neither can the military defence fulfil its tasks.' M wants to secure long-term planning for civil defence, and this work is ongoing through the government. The committee's rejection of opposition motions is consistent with M's role as a governing party. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: If the civil defence does not work, then neither can the military defence fulfil its tasks.
Secure long-term planning for the civil defence

motivering: The Moderates want to double damages for crime victims and facilitate the payment of compensation, but are pursuing this through their own government work. The committee's rejection of the S motions is consistent with M handling crime victim issues through its own legislative process. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Double the damages to crime victims
Facilitate the payment of compensation to crime victims to reduce suffering

motivering: The supplementary amendment budget with a temporary tax on electricity producers' excess revenues is the government's own proposal and implements the EU regulation on energy emergency measures. The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) obliges the cooperation parties to vote for the government's budget in its entirety. M supports the proposal as a temporary measure to handle high electricity prices in accordance with EU law.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
Protect households against winter electricity bills through a high-cost protection scheme
citations.princip: household protection against high electricity prices

motivering: The Left Party's motions on the future design of the Health and Medical Services Act conflict with the Moderates' orientation toward freedom of choice, private alternatives, and patient-focused reforms. The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) emphasises that the best interests of the patient shall be at the centre and that reforms shall improve accessibility and efficiency. V's proposals on increased public governance and restriction of private actors do not fit within M's reform agenda. M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: The patient's best interests shall be at the centre of the reform work
Those who pay taxes should also get value for their paid tax money
citations.princip: freedom of choice and value for taxes

motivering: The Moderates as a governing party are bound by the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) to vote for the entire budget. The fiscal plan guidelines safeguard the surplus target and include a reduced fuel tax and high-cost protection for electricity — measures that directly reflect manifesto promises. The committee's proposal approves the bill and rejects S, V, C, and MP's motions, which is M's natural position.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
In tough economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required. The surplus target shall be safeguarded

motivering: The Moderates are implementing their own preschool and school reforms through the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) with concrete measures such as mandatory language monitoring at age 3 and language preschool. The committee rejects SD's and S's preschool motions with reference to ongoing work, which is consistent with M's own reform programme already under way. As a governing party, M supports the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: Introduce mandatory language monitoring at age 3 to identify children who cannot speak Swedish

citations.quote: The purpose of the project is to develop and implement concrete policy proposals that solve Sweden's most important societal problems in the area of education.
citations.princip: ongoing school reform through the Tidöavtalet

motivering: M prioritises strengthened defence intelligence capability and the capacity of the Security Service (Säkerhetspolisen). The dormant constitutional proposal restricts the freedom of communication (meddelarfriheten) only in cases related to foreign espionage — a limited but justified restriction from a national security perspective. M voted Yes in April 2022 and is now completing the constitutional procedure in a consistent manner.

citations.quote: Strengthen the defence intelligence capability
Strengthen the Security Service to increase its ability to protect liberal democracy and all the country's citizens
citations.princip: the Security Service's capability against security threats

motivering: The committee rejects C's (Centre Party's) motions on the digital environment and culture for children and young people, citing ongoing work. The Moderates have agreed in the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) to conduct a study of the new media landscape and prefer free cultural activity without political direction. As a governing party, M supports the committee's rejection of C's motions.

citations.quote: A study shall be conducted on how the new media landscape affects the conditions for individuals' formation of opinion. The interest of transparency and individuals' position in relation to dominant social platforms shall be specifically monitored.
citations.princip: ongoing media landscape study covers the issue

citations.quote: The Moderate Party's media policy aims to create conditions for a broad range of media in various formats that can operate freely, independently, and in competition with each other.

motivering: The Moderates have explicitly committed to protecting households against high electricity bills through a high-cost protection scheme (högkostnadsskydd). Confidentiality for data identifying electrical installations in electricity support cases is a necessary technical implementation measure for this commitment. M's own documents — the election manifesto and the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) — require swift electricity support for affected households and thereby support the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: Protect households against winter electricity bills through a high-cost protection scheme
A high-cost protection scheme for affected households and businesses as soon as practically possible — with retroactive payment

motivering: The committee rejects SD's and C's motions on corporate law issues, including modernisation of the Accounting Act, citing ongoing work. The Moderates are pursuing regulatory simplification for businesses and improvements to company law through the Tidö agreement's growth project (tillväxtprojekt). M does not need to support opposition motions when its own programme covers the area.

citations.quote: Remove one third of businesses' administrative costs and one third of regulatory red tape
citations.princip: regulatory simplification for businesses in M's own programme

citations.quote: Corporate taxes and capital taxes shall be competitive and promote more new businesses that contribute to jobs, growth, and prosperity.
citations.princip: competition-neutral company law in the growth project

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) obliges the cooperation parties to vote for the government's budget in its entirety; expenditure area 27 (the EU fee) is included in the agreed budget framework. citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.
citations.princip: budget commitment in the Tidö agreement

citations.quote: The EU, together with NATO, is our most important international cooperation by far.

The committee's tillkännagivande (formal request) to say no to new main lines is a direct implementation of M's own manifesto.

citations.quote: Upgrade the current railway instead of investing in high-speed trains that risk being obsolete before they are completed
Repair Sweden's roads so that you can get where you are going safely and on time

motivering: The committee's proposal directly approves M's own motion claim 7 (Kristina Axén Olin et al.) to reject the previous Social Democrat government's tightening of the moderation requirements in the marketing of gambling. M wants to reduce the regulatory burden on businesses and not tighten advertising rules further. Yes is the natural vote.

citations.quote: Remove one third of businesses' administrative costs and one third of regulatory red tape
high taxes, cumbersome permit processes, and bureaucracy put a spanner in the works for innovation and growth

motivering: The Moderates support their government's written communication (skrivelse) welcoming the Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) review and identifying digitalisation as a decisive measure for shorter processing times. The committee's proposal to reject the motions and note the written communication accords with M's principle of more efficient public authority processing. No motion claims point toward a position that better reflects M's documents.

citations.quote: Shorten authorities' processing times through an upper time limit
Remove one third of businesses' administrative costs and one third of regulatory red tape
citations.princip: reduced regulatory red tape and bureaucracy

motivering: M supports ongoing environmental work and Baltic Sea work but has no specific commitment to additional drinking water source protection beyond what is already under way. citations.quote: Strengthen the joint Baltic Sea work on measures against eutrophication and littering
Invest in research on water purification and the expansion of advanced water purification

The party's strong principle that all reforms must be financed within the surplus target suggests that C's and S's proposals for changed student financial aid conditions should be handled in the ordinary budget process. M supports the committee's rejection as a responsible governing party.

Improve the conditions for working professionals to pursue further education at colleges and universities.

motivering: The election manifesto establishes that extraordinary revenues from the energy sector shall be returned to households; the EU's solidarity contribution (solidaritetsbidrag), introduced as a temporary tax on the excess profits of fossil fuel companies, serves precisely this purpose.
