The tension against the manifesto's ban on tax increases is resolved by the fact that the measure is EU-mandated, temporary, and targeted at excess profits — and is proposed by M's own government.

citations.quote: the high revenues that have arisen following the red-green shutdown of nuclear power shall be returned to households
A high-cost protection scheme for affected households and businesses as soon as practically possible — with retroactive payment.

omvarld.faktor: High electricity price SE3 (SEK 3.27/kWh)
omvarld.effekt: Strengthens the need for a solidarity contribution to compensate affected households

omvarld.faktor: High inflation (11.5 %)
omvarld.effekt: Increases households' economic vulnerability and makes support measures more urgent

motivering: M wants to give businesses engaged in security-sensitive activities better government support against cyberattacks and espionage. The protection of critical infrastructure is part of the security policy that M is pursuing as a governing party. The committee's rejection of S's, SD's, and MP's motions reflects that work is under way within the framework of the government's own initiatives. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Give businesses engaged in security-sensitive activities better support from the state to be able to counter cyberattacks, espionage, and theft attempts by foreign powers
Strengthen the Security Police (Säkerhetspolisen) to increase their capacity to protect liberal democracy and all the country's citizens

motivering: The Tidö agreement's climate policy seeks cost-effective measures within existing frameworks and in interaction with EU instruments, not new sector legislation. V's and MP's motions on a new marine environment act are not supported by M's documents. The committee rejects the motions citing ongoing work. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Sweden's climate and environmental policy shall be ambitious. Swedish competitiveness shall be safeguarded. Our shared climate and environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most cost-effective measures, which at the same time do not harm industries and rural areas.
citations.princip: Cost-effective climate measures within existing frameworks

citations.quote: Strengthen the joint Baltic Sea work on measures against eutrophication and littering
citations.princip: Baltic Sea work through existing channels

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) obliges M to support the entire budget. The framework resolution includes a temporarily reduced fuel tax and the repeal of the waste incineration tax — direct manifesto commitments. The fact that M's own motion on alcohol and tobacco tax (Wykman et al.) is rejected in sub-point f does not change the budget loyalty obligation; the whole is approved.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is voted through in the Riksdag.
Lower the price of petrol and diesel so that you can manage your everyday finances
Remove the waste incineration tax to increase electricity production from combined heat and power plants

motivering: M's documents contain no policy on the repatriation of human remains and museum objects. The committee rejects C's and MP's motions with reference to ongoing work. Drawing on M's general principle of equal rights for all and as a governing party supporting the committee's recommendation, M votes Yes.

citations.quote: The Moderates' policy is based on the equal worth of all people and every individual's right to freedom. Sweden shall be a free and open society where rights, obligations and opportunities apply equally to all.
citations.princip: Equal rights of all individuals (closest applicable principle)

motivering: The committee rejects motions from SD, V and MP on exemptions from social contributions for non-profit associations and cultural activities. M's reform work on tax conditions takes place within the coordinated framework of the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet), not through V's and MP's proposals. M supports the committee's rejection and votes Yes.

citations.quote: Corporate taxes and capital taxes shall be competitive and promote more new businesses that contribute to jobs, growth and prosperity.

motivering: V's and MP's motions on children's and young people's right to culture are rejected by the committee with reference to ongoing work. The Moderates safeguard culture's independence and intrinsic value and reject politicised cultural governance in line with the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet). M as a governing party supports the committee's rejection of V's and MP's demands.

citations.quote: Cultural policy shall safeguard the independence and intrinsic value of cultural life towards
The Moderates' media policy aims to create conditions for a broad range of media in different formats that can operate freely, independently and in competition with each other.
citations.princip: free cultural activities without state control

motivering: The committee rejects S's, C's and MP's motions on conditions for pre-school with reference to ongoing work. The Moderates are implementing their own pre-school reforms through their manifesto and the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet), including mandatory language follow-up and language pre-school. These three parties' motions fall outside M's reform agenda and M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: The Moderates will: • Introduce mandatory language follow-up at age 3 to identify children who cannot speak
citations.princip: M's own pre-school measures are ongoing

citations.quote: The purpose of the project is to develop and implement concrete political proposals that solve Sweden's most important social problems in the area of education.
citations.princip: ongoing school reform work through the Tidö agreement

motivering: The committee rejects SD's and S's motions on faith communities with reference to ongoing work. In the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet), the Moderates have decided to appoint an inquiry into a ban on foreign funding of faith communities linked to Islamism, which addresses the core of SD's demands through an ongoing process. M supports the committee's rejection and votes Yes.

citations.quote: An inquiry shall review a ban on foreign funding of faith communities and other organisations in civil society with links to Islamism and extremism
citations.princip: ongoing inquiry into foreign funding of faith communities

citations.quote: Stop payments of taxpayers' money to organisations that do not share the fundamental democratic values of Swedish society but threaten people's freedom

motivering: The committee rejects C's and SD's motions on debt restructuring and damages for crime victims with reference to ongoing work. The Moderates are pursuing strengthened crime victims' rights with their own commitments to double damages and have in the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) decided to review the regulatory framework for criminal injuries compensation. The ongoing reform work makes the opposition's specific motions unnecessary.

citations.quote: Double the damages for crime victims
citations.princip: strengthened crime victim compensation through M's own programme

citations.quote: The regulatory framework for criminal injuries compensation is being reviewed with the aim of reducing the crime victim's responsibility for personally recovering the full damages from the perpetrator.
citations.princip: criminal injuries compensation reviewed through the Tidö agreement

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) obliges M to vote for the entire budget. The discontinuation of the subsidy-based investment support for rental housing is consistent with M's market-oriented housing policy. The committee's rejection of V's motion (item 1) is in line with M's position.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is voted through in the Riksdag.
We shall ensure that more housing is built — including near the shoreline

motivering: The Moderates have no specific commitments regarding a cultural school act (kulturskolelag) in their documents. As a governing party, M supports the committee's assessment that existing measures are sufficient and that new legislation in the KrU (Committee on Cultural Affairs) area is not warranted. The major needs in the justice system and defence leave no room for prioritising new legislation outside M's core reform programme.

citations.quote: The major needs in the justice system, defence and welfare place great demands on prioritisation in the years to come.
We know what must be done — and what can wait.

motivering: The Moderates safeguard the conditions of democratic organisations and the security of faith communities, but the specific motions on civil society support and involuntary loneliness fall outside the Tidö agreement's (Tidöavtalet) cooperation projects. As a governing party, M supports the committee's assessment that ongoing work is sufficient without unilaterally supporting any of the opposition parties' own proposals.

citations.quote: Stop payments of taxpayers' money to organisations that do not share the fundamental democratic values of Swedish society but threaten people's freedom
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on matters covered by the terms of reference for the cooperation projects.

motivering: The Moderates and the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) are clear about expanding charging infrastructure across the country, but this is done within the framework of the government's own programme rather than through the Centre Party's property law amendment proposals on joint property associations (samfälligheter). The committee's assessment that ongoing work is sufficient is consistent with M's position of addressing charging through energy policy.

citations.quote: The funds for expanded charging infrastructure are distributed between support for public charging points for light traffic, support for electrification of heavy transport and more.
Build charging points and charging stations across the country

motivering: S's motion on Global Deal is rejected by the labour market committee. Global Deal is not part of the Tidö agreement's (Tidöavtalet) reform agenda and the Moderates do not unilaterally cooperate with S on labour market issues. M supports the committee's proposal to reject the motion.

citations.quote: The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on matters covered by the terms of reference for the cooperation projects.
citations.princip: no unilateral cooperation with opposition parties

citations.quote: Remove a third of businesses' administrative costs and a third of regulatory red tape

motivering: The committee rejects a motion to develop the chemical tax on electronics, citing that the taxes have not proven sufficiently effective. M's tax freeze (skattehöjarstopp) means that aggregate taxes must not be raised, and the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) prescribes a review of similar energy taxes for greater efficiency — not expansion. M supports the committee's line to reject the motion.

citations.quote: Introduce a tax freeze during the coming term of office meaning that aggregate taxes are not raised
citations.princip: tax freeze during the term of office

citations.quote: The benefit of the support measures, policy instruments, and the state's organisation in the climate area is reviewed.

motivering: The Tidö agreement focuses climate policy instruments on EU coordination and cost-effectiveness, not on new sector-specific trading systems for the Baltic Sea. The committee rejects C's motion on emissions trading in the Baltic Sea, citing ongoing work. M supports the committee's rejection. Vote: Yes.

citations.quote: The benefit of the support measures, policy instruments, and the state's organisation in the climate area is reviewed. This review should also include an assessment of the interaction with policy instruments at the EU level.
citations.princip: EU-coordinated climate instruments, not new national systems

citations.quote: Sweden's climate and environmental policy shall be ambitious. Swedish competitiveness shall be protected. Our joint climate and environmental policy is grounded in the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most cost-effective measures

motivering: The Tidö agreement states that sickness insurance (sjukförsäkringen) should focus on rehabilitation and counteract unnecessarily long periods of sick leave — not on expanding benefit support during illness. The motions from V and S on study grants during sick leave point in a different direction. M supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: Sickness insurance shall provide financial security for those who, due to illness, are unable to work. The focus shall be on rehabilitation and its design shall counteract unnecessarily many periods of sick leave, especially lengthy ones
The surplus target shall be protected and it is not currently appropriate to transition to a balance target.

motivering: The Moderates' documents do not take a specific position on motions concerning children's and young people's influence and participation in the sense addressed by the Committee on Cultural Affairs (KrU). As a governing party, M supports the committee's rejection on the grounds that work is already under way. M's reform agenda for children is focused on a knowledge-based school and safety, not new legislation in the KrU area.

citations.quote: We know what must be done — and what can wait.
The major needs within the justice system, defence, and welfare place great demands on priorities in the years to come.

motivering: M wants to upgrade the existing railway network rather than carry out major structural changes. Motions from SD and V on SJ AB are rejected by the coalition-controlled committee — the company is managed within ordinary ownership governance. M has no reason to support either SD's or V's alternative positions on SJ. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: Upgrade today's railway instead of investing in high-speed trains that risk being obsolete before they are even completed

motivering: The Tidö agreement commits to stricter conditions for labour migration, on the basis that work permits should only be granted when the salary corresponds to the median wage. The proposition's raised maintenance requirements are a direct implementation of this commitment and also strengthen labour migrants' position in the labour market. As part of the government that submitted the proposition, M supports the committee's approval.

citations.quote: The starting point shall be that work permits are only granted if the work to which the labour migration applies normally carries a salary level corresponding to the median wage.
citations.princip: raised income threshold for work permits

citations.quote: Ensure that those who have immigrated qualify for various welfare benefits through work and education

motivering: The Swedish National Audit Office (Riksrevisionen) notes deficiencies in pharmaceutical supervision. The government welcomes the review and the Committee on Health and Welfare accepts the written communication but rejects the opposition motion on measures against overpriced medicines. M supports the committee's line: patient focus and the state's responsibility for healthcare governance are handled within the Tidö agreement's reform work.

citations.quote: The patient's best interest shall be at the centre of the reform work.
citations.princip: patient focus in healthcare reform work

citations.quote: The state takes overall responsibility for the governance and follow-up of state funds for healthcare.

motivering: The Finance Committee proposes that the Riksdag notes the government's written communication on price and salary revaluation (PLO — pris- och löneomräkning, a system for adjusting state appropriations) and rejects V's motion. M demands 'order and discipline in the economy' and protects transparent, predictable budget processes. The PLO system supports state efficiency, which M endorses. M votes Yes with the committee.

citations.quote: In difficult economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required. The surplus target shall be protected and it is not currently appropriate to transition to a balance target.
citations.princip: order and discipline in the economy

motivering: The committee notes the 2022 report on state-owned companies and rejects motions from SD, C, and MP. The Tidö agreement establishes that state-owned companies shall be governed according to 'standard principles for the state's ownership governance,' which the government's own written communication upholds. M supports its government's report and votes Yes.

citations.quote: The governance of Vattenfall shall follow the standard principles for the state's ownership governance.
Bromma Airport shall be preserved. No decision to close Bromma Airport will be made during the term of office.

motivering: The Tidö agreement expresses M's desire to reform the inheritance fund (allmänna arvsfonden) to include crime victim work and to require democratic values from recipient organisations. Procedurally noting the previous S-government's 2021 written communication and rejecting the opposition motion does not impede M's reform work, which is being carried out through the Tidö agreement.

citations.quote: The starting point shall be that the inheritance fund's allocation of funds is changed to include, among other things, crime victim work.

An investigative process shall be carried out to ensure that organisations and associations receiving funds from the general inheritance fund use them correctly with clear reporting of results and that they comply with democratic values.

motivering: The government, of which M is a part, shares the National Audit Office's conclusions and refers to the National Board of Health and Welfare's (Socialstyrelsen) ongoing work on national guidelines for medical certificates. The committee's proposal to note the written communication and reject SD's motion is compatible with M's line on state governance and follow-up of healthcare quality. Further Riksdag measures are not needed when the government and its agencies are already addressing the matter.

citations.quote: The state takes overall responsibility for the governance and follow-up of state funds for healthcare.
citations.princip: state overall responsibility for healthcare governance

citations.quote: trengthened follow-up of healthcare efficiency and quality reporting

motivering: The committee rejects the previous (S-)government's proposition on GDP indexation of the waste incineration tax and the chemical tax, and approves M's own motion by Niklas Wykman et al. M has explicitly proposed abolishing the waste incineration tax, and the Tidö agreement states it should be reviewed for the benefit of combined heat and power (kraftvärme) — GDP indexation contradicts both of these commitments.

citations.quote: Remove the waste incineration tax in order to increase electricity production from combined heat and power plants
The combined heat and power tax, the waste incineration tax, and the tax on bio-oil are reviewed in order to create better conditions for combined heat and power.
citations.princip: waste tax reviewed for combined heat and power

citations.quote: Introduce a tax freeze during the coming term of office meaning that aggregate taxes are not raised
citations.princip: tax freeze during the term of office

motivering: M has a clear commitment to defence appropriations of 2 percent of GDP as early as 2025 and to preparing for NATO membership. The Defence Committee rejects the motions (from C, SD and S) with reference to ongoing work that encompasses precisely these goals. M fully supports the committee's line and votes Yes.

citations.quote: Work to ensure that defence appropriations amount to the equivalent of 2 percent of GDP as early as 2025
Prepare the defence for Swedish NATO membership

motivering: The Moderates emphasise responsible fiscal policy where expenditures are weighed against each other in the budget process. The Left Party's demand for increased resources (motion point 3) without connection to M's reform agenda lacks support in M's documents. The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) clarifies that budget-affecting proposals are handled in the ordinary budget process without an automatic financing guarantee. M supports the committee's rejection of V's motion point.

citations.quote: In tough economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required. The surplus target must be safeguarded and it is not relevant to switch to a balance target.
There is no guarantee that matters prepared in the project are automatically guaranteed financing in the budget bill.

motivering: M's documents contain no specific commitment regarding the level of the free amount (fribeloppet). The matter is determined by M's role as a governing party — the incumbent Kristersson government controls the committee and supports the rejection of the motions. M votes Yes pending the issue being handled within the fiscal framework.

citations.quote: The surplus target must be safeguarded and it is not relevant to switch to a balance target. All new commitments and reforms — such as our income tax cuts — must be financed or accommodated within the surplus target.

omvarld.faktor: M is a governing party in the Kristersson coalition
omvarld.effekt: Determines the vote in the absence of a party-political position on the free amount — M supports its own committee's rejection

motivering: The Moderates have explicitly committed to protecting households against high electricity bills through a high-cost protection scheme (högkostnadsskydd). Confidentiality regarding individuals' personal circumstances in the Swedish Social Insurance Agency's (Försäkringskassan's) administration of electricity support is a necessary privacy measure in the implementation. The Tidö agreement prescribes that electricity support shall be provided 'as soon as practically possible'. M's documents support the committee's proposal and the underlying government bill.

citations.quote: Protect households against winter electricity bills through a high-cost protection scheme
A high-cost protection scheme for affected households and businesses as soon as practically possible — with retroactive payment

motivering: The Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen's) review of regional policy led to a communication from M's government which the committee is now noting and filing. M wants the whole of Sweden to function and prioritises infrastructure for jobs and growth in all parts of the country. The committee rejects opposition motions and M supports this. M votes Yes.

citations.quote: High-quality infrastructure is important for jobs and growth in all parts of the country.
The Moderates want to harness the opportunities of the whole of Sweden.
citations.princip: the whole of Sweden shall function

motivering: The Tidö agreement explicitly stipulates that the Settlement Act (bosättningslagen) is to be abolished in due course and replaced with a model with greater municipal influence. The motions of MP, C and S do not seek to abolish the act but to amend it in other directions. M supports the committee's rejection and awaits its own announced reform.

citations.quote: The Settlement Act/Referral Act (bosättningslagen/anvisningslagen) should be reviewed with regard to the weighting of the factors governing the distribution of newly arrived immigrants and that the housing situation in a municipality should constitute an additional factor. The act should in due course be abolished and replaced with a model with greater municipal influence.
citations.princip: Abolish the Settlement Act in due course

citations.quote: Our integration capacity shall govern the level of immigration.

motivering: The Moderates want order and discipline in the economy with responsible monetary policy. The new Riksbank Act strengthens the Riksbank's independence and clarifies the price stability mandate, which aligns well with M's economic-policy principles. V's motion (Mia Sydow Mölleby et al.) is rightly rejected.

citations.quote: In tough economic times, order and discipline in the economy are required. The surplus target must be safeguarded
citations.princip: order and discipline in the economy

citations.quote: Sweden needs to find its way back to a responsible economic policy that builds resilience against crises

motivering: The Moderates defend a free housing market and oppose state intervention in property transactions. A pre-emption law as proposed by V and S runs counter to M's principle of market solutions and property rights in the housing sector. The committee's rejection of these left-wing proposals is fully in line with M's housing-policy profile.

citations.quote: Stop the left from reintroducing the property tax • Retain the interest deduction
citations.princip: no to left-wing intervention in the property market

citations.quote: Enable fairer rents by giving greater weight to prospective tenants' valuation of the dwelling
citations.princip: market solutions in the housing sector

motivering: The Moderates have in a related vote (same committee report) voted to reject tightened marketing rules for gambling. V's motion point 2 seeks to go in an even more restrictive direction. The committee's proposal to reject V's motion is consistent with M's position on reduced regulatory burden for the gambling market.

citations.quote: Remove a third of companies' administrative costs and a third of the regulatory red tape
Lower administrative costs for businesses.

motivering: The Green Party (Miljöpartiet) has no motion in the matter concerning the state's supervision of pharmacies and wholesale trade medicines, and the election manifesto does not address pharmacy supervision specifically. The committee shares the National Audit Office's conclusions on the importance of effective supervision for patient safety, which does not conflict with the party's general health care policy. In the absence of its own motion points, the vote falls back on the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: shorten the queues for treatment across the country

motivering: The independent dispute resolution mechanism expands tenants' access to review possibilities even in the private rental market, which is consistent with MP's goal of strengthening tenants' position. Streamlined negotiations reduce financial uncertainty for tenants who would otherwise lack a dispute resolution mechanism. MP supports the committee's proposal on this proposal from the previous government.

citations.quote: strengthen tenants' position during renovation
build more climate-smart rental apartments with reasonable rents

motivering: MP's election manifesto requires that Sweden shall 'speed up the construction of new main lines for high-speed trains'. The committee proposes a formal request (tillkännagivande) to say no to building high-speed railways and also rejects MP's own motion (motion point 22 by Per Bolund et al.). Voting yes would be to directly counter the party's railway policy. MP votes no and supports reservation 11 which is presumed to protect the high-speed line.

citations.quote: speed up the construction of new main lines for high-speed trains
expand and upgrade the railway network for fast trains across the country

motivering: The manifesto contains no specific cyber policy. The motions being rejected are from C, SD and S — no MP-own proposals are affected in this vote. Without knowledge of what Reservation 12 contains, the party cannot confirm that its own line is represented, and MP follows the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: invest a larger share of defence funds in civil defence, and increase appropriations for crisis preparedness

motivering: MP wants to increase appropriations for crisis preparedness and invest more in civil defence. The deteriorating security situation resulting from Russia's invasion of Ukraine strengthens the application of these demands. The committee's proposal rejects C's and SD's motions, whose positions do not align with MP's demands on military non-alignment and crisis preparedness priorities. A Yes vote supports an increased defence and crisis preparedness budget without a NATO orientation.

citations.quote: invest a larger share of defence funds in civil defence, and increase appropriations for crisis preparedness

At the same time, we want Sweden to retain its military non-alignment in order to continue working against nuclear weapons, for disarmament, and to conduct an independent foreign policy in which we stand up for human rights

omvarld.faktor: Russia's invasion of Ukraine is ongoing
omvarld.effekt: Strengthens the application of MP's own demands for heightened crisis preparedness and civil defence

motivering: MP's electoral manifesto does not address the distraint prohibition explicitly. Without documentary support for SD's specific proposal 13, and based on the party's general positions normally not coinciding with SD's legal reform agenda, MP supports the committee's rejection of the SD motion. Reservation 3 (SD) receives no support.

citations.quote: Those with the fewest resources shall receive more public services, lower taxes and more support in the transition.
citations.princip: Protection for those with limited resources

motivering: The proposal introduces a sustainability goal for the Seventh AP Fund (Sjunde AP-fonden), which is compatible with MP's green profile and desire to direct capital towards sustainable investments. Improving the default option strengthens pension protection for those who do not actively choose, reflecting MP's priority of helping those with the lowest pensions. The committee's rejection of V's motion is compatible with preserving and improving the system.

citations.quote: raise the guarantee pension and reform the pension system with the aim of raising pensions, most for those with the lowest pensions
citations.princip: strengthened pension protection for low-income earners

citations.quote: phase out fossil fuel subsidies

motivering: Märta Stenevi et al. (MP) have submitted proposals 20 and 21 on employment rate and labour law, which the committee rejects. The electoral manifesto explicitly advocates stronger conditions for workers and reduced working hours. MP should vote against the committee's proposal to defend its own proposals on labour law reforms.

citations.quote: reduce working hours so that more people can manage to work a full working life
citations.princip: reduced working hours and better working conditions

motivering: The proposal gives the Riksdag the possibility to restrict freedom of association for terrorist organisations via ordinary legislation, which is compatible with MP's commitment to combat organised crime and protect democracy. The constitutional process has been correctly followed — the dormant proposal was originally adopted in April 2022 and a general election has been held in between, which is not a 'rapid change'. MP supports the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: In the green people's home it shall be so difficult and unprofitable to conduct organised crime that the gangs withdraw.
protect Sweden's constitution from rapid changes

motivering: MP wants to 'develop and strengthen Sweden's feminist foreign and development policy' and aid should contribute to 'preserving and creating peace' and 'building democratic societies.' Women's participation in post-conflict reconstruction is the core of feminist foreign policy. The committee's rejection of C's motions contradicts this commitment.

citations.quote: develop and strengthen Sweden's feminist foreign and development policy

that development cooperation should contribute to combating poverty, preventing and managing climate change, preserving and creating peace, preventing conflicts, building democratic societies and counteracting corruption

motivering: The manifesto advocates extending the establishment programme (etableringsprogrammet) to at least four years to improve newly arrived immigrants' establishment in the labour market. The committee rejects MP's own proposals 2 and 3 (Annika Hirvonen et al.), which advance this line. The party should vote no and support Reservation 6 in order to stand behind its documented position.

citations.quote: extend the establishment programme for newly arrived immigrants to at least four years to create better conditions for establishment, so that more people enter employment more quickly
Those who are entitled to asylum shall be welcomed and given the opportunity to establish themselves in Sweden

motivering: The manifesto does not address gambling regulation specifically. SD's proposal 2 (Reservation 14) concerns gambling marketing or the ferry agreement with Finland, and SD generally takes a more permissive stance on marketing. MP's general principle of solidarity and desire to protect vulnerable groups speaks in favour of supporting the committee's stricter regulation rather than SD's alternative.

citations.quote: We want to build strong safety nets so that everyone can feel secure and no one is left outside.
citations.princip: protect the vulnerable (social solidarity, by analogy)

citations.quote: solidarity with all people of the world

motivering: MP's electoral manifesto wants to 'expand public transport throughout the country' and improve support for people with disabilities, which directly relates to the paratransit (färdtjänst) issue. The committee's rejection of the motions on paratransit and public transport counteracts these goals. Reservation 16 is assessed to support expanded accessibility and extended public transport, which is why MP votes no to the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: expand public transport throughout the country, and make it cheaper to travel by bus and train, especially for young people and pensioners
improve support for people with disabilities and rare diagnoses regardless of where you live in the country

motivering: The committee has rejected the most privacy-sensitive provision (Chapter 27, Section 2 on covert coercive measures) and retains only procedural changes for foreign espionage cases. The remaining parts do not affect freedom of the press in the same way as the amendments to the Freedom of the Press Act (TF/tryckfrihetsförordningen) and the Fundamental Law on Freedom of Expression (YGL/yttrandefrihetsgrundlagen). Given the real espionage threat from Russia, MP accepts the committee's adjusted compromise with a reservation regarding freedom of expression aspects.

citations.quote: strengthen freedom of expression and support independent media throughout the country
Freedom of speech, minority rights and protection against discrimination are important for democratic development, together with a strong and independent rule of law.

omvarld.faktor: Russia's invasion of Ukraine is ongoing
omvarld.effekt: A real espionage threat motivates anti-espionage legislation and weighs in when balancing freedoms

motivering: The committee rejects SD's motion (proposals 6, 9, 10) on chemicals policy with reference to ongoing work. MP wants to 'phase out toxic substances immediately' within the framework of EU chemicals legislation. SD's chemicals policy direction likely deviates from MP's EU-based, precautionary-oriented line. Supporting the committee's rejection of the SD motion is compatible with MP's approach.

citations.quote: phase out toxic substances immediately, especially from products for children

motivering: The committee's proposal (driven by M+SD+KD+L) rejects a supervision requirement designed to ensure that private care providers' insurance assignments do not harm care provided on behalf of the region. MP's manifesto demands the right to good care regardless of place of residence, which presupposes transparency and oversight of private actors. Rejecting the proposition is contrary to MP's position on equivalent and controlled care.

citations.quote: You shall have the right to good care, regardless of where in the country you live.
raise wages and secure a good working environment in healthcare.

motivering: MP wants to phase out fossil subsidies and is driving a rapid climate transition to a fossil-free society by 2030 at the latest. The AP funds' investment in companies that lobby for fossil fuels directly undermines the climate targets. The committee's proposal to reject the motion banning such investments is contrary to MP's climate policy.

citations.quote: phase out fossil subsidies.
invest at least 100 billion per year in transitioning so that Sweden becomes a fossil-free welfare state by 2030 at the latest.

motivering: The election manifesto contains no specific positions on income thresholds for work permits but advocates making it easier for foreign-born individuals to enter society and the labour market. Raised thresholds for work permits risk excluding low-wage earners from legal employment. V's reservation (Alternative A) better reflects the party's pro-integration stance, and the party votes No.

citations.quote: shorten processing times for work permits and asylum decisions so that it goes faster to enter society
strengthen foreign-born women's establishment through SFI (Swedish for Immigrants) combined with work placements and vocational training, and gender-equal measures from the public employment service.
citations.princip: strengthen foreign-born individuals in working life

motivering: The party wants to strengthen rule of law in the asylum process and support for vulnerable groups. The strengthened system with raised identity requirements for coordination numbers (samordningsnummer) risks harming asylum seekers without complete identity documents and making their contact with authorities more difficult. V's motion for the assignment of coordination numbers to asylum seekers (Reservation 2) better aligns with the party's protection ambitions.

citations.quote: strengthen rule of law in the asylum process and support for LGBTQI refugees and other vulnerable groups.
citations.princip: support for asylum seekers and the vulnerable

citations.quote: shorten processing times for work permits and asylum decisions so that it goes faster to enter society

motivering: The election manifesto advocates modernising copyright law to protect the rights of cultural creators. The implementation of the EU directive strengthens authors' contractual position vis-à-vis publishers and platforms, introduces press remuneration, and regulates platform liability. The committee's proposal to approve the government's proposition is directly in line with the party's cultural policy ambitions.

citations.quote: improve cultural creators' economic and social conditions and modernise copyright law so that the rights of cultural creators are protected

motivering: V's motion 5 on limitations of enforcement in cases of inadequate credit assessment strengthens protection for indebted consumers against creditors who have not fulfilled their assessment obligation. MP's election manifesto lacks explicit text on insolvency law but emphasises that 'those with the least resources shall receive more support'. Reservation 4 supports this consumer protection stance and MP votes no against the committee's rejection.

The manifesto demands a strengthened cultural school (kulturskola) and investment in children's culture at school — exactly what the motion seeks to achieve. Supporting the committee's rejection of the party's own motion would be inconsistent; MP should vote No.

citations.quote: strengthen the cultural school (kulturskola) and establish a cultural school act (kulturskolelag)
invest in children's culture at school, with trained staff in all school libraries and arts subjects in all upper secondary programmes

motivering: The committee's proposal rejects MP's own motion item (Märta Stenevi et al., motion item 44) on the conditions for developing pre-school (förskolan). The manifesto's demand for 'smaller child groups and more staff in pre-school' mirrors exactly what is being rejected. Voting Yes would be to work against the party's own motion — MP should vote No and support Reservation 8.

citations.quote: invest in smaller child groups and more staff in pre-school
In the new green welfare state (folkhemmet), resources for school and pre-school are distributed according to need so that every child succeeds in their education and thrives

motivering: The matter is dominated by SD motions on support for religious communities (trossamfund), which most likely aim to restrict support to specific religious groups. MP's manifesto states that no one should be subjected to discrimination 'on grounds such as faith', which means the party should support the committee's rejection of these SD motion items. Reservation 13 is most likely an SD reservation.

citations.quote: In our Sweden, no one shall be subjected to racism or discrimination on grounds such as faith, sexual orientation, or disability
For Miljöpartiet (the Green Party), the equal worth of all people is a matter of course
citations.princip: the equal worth of all people

motivering: The matter concerns technical rules on debt restructuring (skuldsanering) and damages — issues not directly covered by MP's electoral manifesto. Without clear positions in the party's documents, and with the committee's reference to ongoing work in the area, Yes is the most cautious line. The decision rests not on an explicit commitment but on the absence of guidance.

citations.quote: We want to build strong safety nets so that everyone can feel secure and no one is left behind
Those with the fewest resources shall receive more public services, lower taxes, and more support in the transition
citations.princip: support for those with the fewest resources

motivering: MP wants to 'develop and expand the investment grant' for climate-smart rental apartments at reasonable rents, but the government's budget is phasing out precisely this grant. The committee's proposal approves the phase-out and rejects V's motion, which most likely calls for the grant to be retained — in line with MP's manifesto. Voting Yes would be to actively support a policy that directly contradicts an explicit manifesto pledge; MP therefore votes No.

citations.quote: build more climate-smart rental apartments at reasonable rents, develop and expand the investment grant that made it cheaper to build
stop renovation evictions (renovräkningar). Renovation must not be so luxurious that people are evicted from their homes.

motivering: The committee intends to reject MP's own motion (Amanda Lind et al., motion item 1) on a cultural school act (kulturskolelag). The electoral manifesto is explicit: MP wants to 'establish a cultural school act.' Voting Yes would mean the party actively rejects its own motion item. MP should vote No and support Reservation 7, which represents the party's line.

citations.quote: strengthen the cultural school (kulturskola) and establish a cultural school act (kulturskolelag)
invest in children's culture at school, with trained staff in all school libraries and arts subjects in all upper secondary programmes

motivering: MP's own motion (Amanda Lind et al., motion item 5) on support for civil society is rejected by the committee. The electoral manifesto emphasises investment in 'non-profit actors' within the recovery of cultural life and support for outdoor recreation organisations, pointing towards strong support for civil society organisations. MP should vote No to defend its own motion item.

citations.quote: invest in a broad recovery plan for cultural life across the country, encompassing both public, independent, professional, and non-profit actors
give more funding to outdoor recreation organisations so that more people can enjoy Swedish nature

motivering: The matter concerns charging facilities within property associations (samfälligheter) for electric vehicles. The election manifesto requires that 'the state shall take responsibility where the market falls short' for charging across the whole country. Charging infrastructure in property associations is a direct part of this initiative. Reservation 4 supports such facilities and MP should vote No.

citations.quote: invest in charging across the whole country — the state shall take responsibility where the market falls short, so that cars and lorries can run on electricity regardless of where in the country they are going
citations.princip: charging infrastructure across the whole country

citations.quote: that anyone who needs a car shall be able to afford a climate-smart alternative, and that only fossil-free cars shall be sold from 2025

motivering: MP wants to phase out toxic substances immediately, particularly from products for children, and wants products to meet strict environmental requirements. The committee rejects the motion to develop the chemicals tax on electronics, while reservation 3 likely supports a strengthened tax instrument. MP's consistent approach of using taxes and bans to steer away from hazardous chemicals leads to support for the reservation and a No vote against the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: phase out toxic substances immediately, especially from products for children
ban products that are manufactured to break down prematurely

motivering: The committee rejects C's motion on an emissions trading system for the Baltic Sea. MP supports market instruments for environmental protection and wants to 'raise the price of emission allowances in the EU, include emissions from aviation and shipping in the system.' A trading system for the Baltic Sea contributes to 'saving the coastal ecosystem.' The reservation aligns better with MP's environmental policy.

citations.quote: raise the price of emission allowances in the EU, include emissions from aviation and shipping in the system and introduce climate tariffs on goods from countries outside the EU
save the coastal ecosystem — restore destroyed environments

motivering: The manifesto demands better security during sick leave and improved support for people with disabilities. These demands directly cover what reservation 7 concerns: student grants during sick leave and for students with disabilities. The Left Party and the Social Democrats are pursuing similar motions. The party should vote no.

citations.quote: improve support for people with disabilities and rare diagnoses regardless of where in the country you live
reform the sickness insurance so that it provides better security during sick leave and ensure that people are not passed between authorities when they need society's support
raise student financial support and improve students' unemployment insurance and sickness insurance

motivering: The matter concerns children's and young people's right to culture, influence, and participation, which the motions from S (the Social Democrats) highlight. The election manifesto establishes that MP wants to invest in 'children's culture in schools' and strengthen the kulturskolan (municipal arts school). Reservation 10 supports expanded influence for children and young people in cultural matters, which is in line with MP's children's cultural policy.

citations.quote: invest in children's culture in schools, with trained staff at all school libraries and arts subjects in all upper secondary programmes
strengthen the kulturskolan (municipal arts school) and establish a kulturskola act

motivering: MP's manifesto strongly advocates expanding the rail network and public investment in train services. The motions on SJ AB are from SD and V, and the content of Reservation 9 is unknown. Since SD's and V's positions on public ownership differ from each other, and without support in the documents for what the reservation contains, MP votes with the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: expand and upgrade the rail network for fast trains across the whole country and accelerate the construction of new main lines for high-speed trains
The state should sell SAS and invest the money in railways

motivering: MP's own motions (Annika Hirvonen et al.) are rejected if the committee's proposal is adopted, showing that the party actively opposes the raised maintenance requirement (försörjningskrav). The manifesto emphasises shortening processing times for work permits and strengthening the establishment of foreign-born persons — not adding new barriers. A raised maintenance requirement risks excluding labour migrants rather than protecting them. MP votes No and supports Reservation 1.

citations.quote: shorten processing times for work permits and asylum decisions so that it becomes faster to enter into society
citations.princip: Facilitate access to the labour market

citations.quote: extend the establishment programme for newly arrived immigrants to at least four years to create better conditions for establishment, so that more people enter employment more quickly
strengthen foreign-born women's establishment through SFI (Swedish for Immigrants) combined with work placements and vocational training and gender-equal measures from the Employment Service
citations.princip: Supporting foreign-born people in the labour market

motivering: Miljöpartiet (the Green Party) has no motion in the matter and the election manifesto takes no position on the technical construction of the PLO model or the productivity deduction for government agencies. The committee's proposal to note the communication (skrivelsen) is a procedural decision without ideological significance. In the absence of its own motions and without guidance from the party programme, the vote falls back on the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: We want to build strong safety nets so that everyone can feel secure and no one is left behind

motivering: Per Bolund et al. (MP) have submitted motion 23 on state ownership of companies, which the committee rejects. The election manifesto advocates active state ownership management in line with climate and environmental goals, exemplified by the call to sell SAS and invest in railways. MP should vote against the committee's proposal in order to defend its own motion.

citations.quote: The state should sell SAS and invest the money in railways
citations.princip: active state ownership with climate benefit

motivering: The documents lack specific policy on the General Inheritance Fund (Allmänna arvsfonden). The General Inheritance Fund finances projects for children, young people, and people with disabilities — groups that MP consistently prioritises. The committee's proposal to note the accounts is standard procedure that MP can accept without it conflicting with the party's principles.

citations.quote: make large investments in preventive work in socioeconomically disadvantaged areas
improve support for people with disabilities and rare diagnoses regardless of where in the country you live

motivering: The committee notes the communication and assumes that the government follows the National Board of Health and Welfare's (Socialstyrelsen) ongoing work on improved decision support — an approach compatible with MP's goal of strengthening security during sick leave. There is nothing in the manifesto that points towards SD's reservation, and the committee's approach entails continued follow-up of the Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) recommendations rather than dismissing the shortcomings.

citations.quote: reform the sickness insurance so that it provides better security during sick leave and ensure that people are not passed between authorities when they need society's support
invest in primary care and increase access to care for mental illness

motivering: MP supports environmental taxes as a policy instrument for phasing out hazardous chemicals and reducing climate impact. The committee's proposal rejects the government's GDP indexation and follows M's and SD's motions to freeze the taxes, which erodes their real level. Reservation 1 likely preserves the indexation, which better aligns with MP's principle of strong and long-term environmental taxes.

citations.quote: phase out toxic substances immediately, especially from products for children
raise the price of emission allowances in the EU, include emissions from aviation and shipping in the system and introduce climate tariffs on goods from countries outside the EU

motivering: The committee rejects motions from C, SD and S on defence policy direction. MP's election manifesto emphasises that defence resources should primarily go to civil defence and crisis preparedness rather than military rearmament, and that military non-alignment should be preserved. None of the three motioners' lines coincide with MP's own priorities, which is why the committee's rejection is compatible with the party's position.

citations.quote: invest a larger share of defence funds in civil defence, and increase appropriations for crisis preparedness
Sweden retains its military non-alignment in order to continue working against nuclear weapons, for disarmament, and to conduct an independent foreign policy in which we stand up for human rights

motivering: V's motion point 3 on increased resources for health and medical care is compatible with MP's manifesto goal of investing in primary care and securing better resources in the healthcare sector. Rejecting such a resource increase conflicts with MP's commitments to strengthened and well-funded healthcare. MP should support Reservation 4.

citations.quote: invest in primary care and increase access to care for mental illness.
raise wages and ensure a good working environment in healthcare.
citations.princip: strengthened healthcare with the right resources

motivering: The manifesto advocates a generally raised study grant (studiestöd) and better conditions for students. The income ceiling (fribelopp) sets a cap on how much students can earn without losing their study grant; Reservation 6 pushes for relaxation of these conditions, which is compatible with the party's goal of strengthened economic security for students. The party should vote no.

citations.quote: raise the study grant and improve students' unemployment insurance and sickness insurance

motivering: Confidentiality for personal circumstances in electricity support cases is not covered by MP's election manifesto. MP (Per Bolund et al.) submitted a motion on this matter that the committee rejects; Reservation 1 most likely represents MP's line. MP should support its own reservation line and vote against the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: Those with the fewest resources should receive more public services, lower taxes, and more support in the transition.
citations.princip: protect households with the fewest resources

omvarld.faktor: High electricity prices (SE3: 0.89 SEK/kWh January 2023)
omvarld.effekt: The electricity support is a crisis measure; MP's motion concerned how confidentiality regarding support recipients' personal circumstances should be regulated

motivering: The Green Party (Miljöpartiet) has no motion in the matter of regional development policy and the election manifesto provides no specific guidance on the National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionen) review of the organisation of regional policy. The committee's proposal to note the written communication and reject the other parties' motions is a procedural decision. In the absence of its own motions, the vote defaults to the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: expand public transport across the entire country, and make it cheaper to travel by bus and train, especially for young people and pensioners
citations.princip: expanded services across the whole country

motivering: The manifesto establishes that those who have the right to asylum should be welcomed and given the opportunity to settle in Sweden, and that the establishment programme (etableringsprogrammet) should be extended to at least four years. The committee rejects MP's own motion (Rasmus Ling et al.) on the Settlement Act (bosättningslagen). The party should vote no and support Reservation 1.

citations.quote: Those who have the right to asylum should be welcomed and given the opportunity to settle in Sweden
extend the establishment programme for newly arrived immigrants to at least four years to create better conditions for establishment, so that more people enter employment more quickly

motivering: The new Riksbank Act strengthens the institution's independence and introduces a requirement for the Riksbank to contribute to sustainable financial market development — a commitment that directly aligns with MP's sustainability profile. Strengthened democratic oversight of the Riksbank and clearer allocation of responsibilities benefit society's functioning. MP supports the committee's proposal and rejects V's reservation.

citations.quote: We strive for a world where everyone can live good lives without impairing the conditions for future generations
citations.princip: sustainability in all sectors of society

citations.quote: protect Sweden's constitution against rapid changes

motivering: The matter concerns the pre-emption act (förköpslag), which gives municipalities the right to acquire properties before another buyer. The election manifesto emphasises that more climate-smart rental housing (hyresrätter) with reasonable rents should be built and that homelessness should be reduced. A pre-emption act is a municipal instrument for securing land for affordable housing, which supports these goals.

citations.quote: build more climate-smart rental housing with reasonable rents
reduce homelessness through a national strategy that genuinely reduces homelessness

motivering: The documents do not cover gambling advertising regulation explicitly. However, MP's fundamental social-protection outlook argues in favour of supporting strengthened regulation of gambling advertising that protects vulnerable groups. The committee's rejection of V's demands for strengthened gambling regulation conflicts with MP's principle of strong safety nets, which is why the party should vote no and support the reservation.

citations.quote: We want to build the safety nets strong so that everyone can feel secure and no one is left out
citations.princip: strong safety nets for the vulnerable

citations.quote: tax crimes and every slot machine that lacks a licence. It should be costly, troublesome and difficult to be a criminal

motivering: The matter concerns effective state supervision of pharmacies and pharmaceutical trade to guarantee patient safety. S's election manifesto calls for stepped-up supervision of healthcare and safe care. The committee's proposal to note the written communication — which welcomes improved supervision — is consistent with S's own demands, and V's and C's motions do not address issues where S's documents point to a different position.

citations.quote: Supervision of healthcare shall be stepped up to guarantee quality.
No one should need to worry about receiving care in time.

motivering: S's previous government proposed this new independent dispute resolution system for collective rental disputes. The system streamlines negotiations in the rental market and contributes to more stable tenancy conditions — an issue S prioritises. The committee approves the proposal and rejects V's motion, which S should support.

citations.quote: We shall continue to build rental housing that ordinary people can afford to live in.
Overcrowding shall be combated.

motivering: The committee rejects S's own motions (Fredrik Olovsson motion point 9 and Gunilla Svantorp motion points 5–7 and 19) and issues a tillkännagivande (formal request to the government) against high-speed rail. The manifesto commits to massive railway investments for climate-smart travel, which directly contradicts the formal request. The party supports Reservation 11, which carries its own line.

citations.quote: Through massive investments in both new and existing railways, more people will be able to travel in a climate-smart way by train
The climate policy framework shall remain in place. Through public investment we can increase the pace of industrial transition and facilitate a climate-smart life

motivering: The manifesto establishes that the work to strengthen the capacity to withstand cyberattacks and disinformation shall be reinforced. S's own motion (Kallifatides et al.) on cyber policy is rejected by the committee. S should vote No to support its reservation and push for a stronger cyber defence.

citations.quote: The work to strengthen the capacity to withstand cyberattacks and disinformation shall be reinforced.
We must be able to defend ourselves militarily, but also against hybrid attacks, espionage and cyberattacks.

motivering: S's manifesto commits to the two-percent target for defence appropriations by 2028 at the latest and demands accelerated rearmament. The committee's proposal approves the defence budget of 94 billion and rejects the dissenting motions from C and SD. Nothing in the committee's line conflicts with S's defence ambitions. S votes Yes.

citations.quote: The appropriations for the military defence shall increase to the equivalent of two percent of GDP. This shall happen as quickly as is practically possible and no later than 2028.
Strengthen the civil defence. The work to reinforce the civil defence and emergency preparedness must continue.

omvarld.faktor: Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the sharply deteriorated security situation
omvarld.effekt: Strengthens S's motivation to immediately support a substantially increased defence budget

motivering: The matter concerns exemptions from distraint in insolvency law – an area not covered by S's election manifesto. The committee rejects SD's motion item 13; the manifesto gives no support for accommodating SD's alternative (Reservation 3). Without a specific party position, S follows the committee's line.

citations.quote: Sweden shall have secure social insurance built on the idea of duty and rights.

motivering: The Seventh AP Fund's sustainability target and the improved management of the default option support S's goal of secure and high-quality pensions. The sustainability target aligns with S's climate commitments. V's reservation (Alternative A) offers an alternative position, but S's manifesto advocates broad systemic improvements rather than V's more restrictive line.

citations.quote: Our goal is for everyone to receive at least 70 percent of their final salary in pension.
Sweden shall have secure social insurance built on the idea of duty and rights.

motivering: The election manifesto emphasises that more measures are needed for foreign-born women to enter employment and that everyone must participate actively in society and the labour market. The committee rejects C's and MP's motions on the establishment of newly arrived women without adopting the active labour market measures S advocates. S's Reservation 11 reflects S's active integration line; S votes no.

citations.quote: More measures are needed for foreign-born women to enter employment.
Everyone who can work shall work and contribute in order to become part of society.

motivering: V's and MP's motions on employment rates and fixed-term employment concern S's core principle of permanent full-time positions. S's election manifesto states that more people shall be able to work full-time in permanent jobs, which points towards not supporting a committee proposal that rejects motions on strengthened employment protection. Reservation 2 (Alternative A) is more consistent with S's labour law principles.

citations.quote: We want welfare to take priority and for more people to be able to work full-time in permanent jobs.
Work is the foundation of economic policy. Full employment is our overarching goal.

motivering: S's criminal policy plan demands an uncompromising fight against terrorism. The constitutional amendment opens the way for ordinary legislation to ban terrorist organisations, which directly supports S's ambition that the full force of society shall be mobilised against crime. S supported the proposal at the first vote in April 2022 (under an S-led government) and has no documented reasons to change its position.

citations.quote: The fight against crime shall be uncompromising. Society's full force shall be mobilised to push back the criminals.
We want to take strong action against the smuggling of weapons and narcotics, including through strengthened border control.

omvarld.faktor: Terrorist attack in Istanbul on 13 November
omvarld.effekt: Elevated terrorist threat in Europe strengthens the rationale for legislation against terrorist organisations

motivering: The committee rejects S's own motion (Teresa Carvalho et al., item 7) on the target group for the establishment programme (etableringsprogrammet). The manifesto states that integration must be improved and that more measures are needed for foreign-born persons to establish themselves in the labour market. S supports its reservation (6) and votes No against the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: More measures are needed for foreign-born women to enter employment.
citations.princip: measures for the establishment of foreign-born persons

citations.quote: Integration must be improved and social cohesion must increase.

motivering: S's manifesto is categorical: the party will never participate in giving power to the Sweden Democrats. The committee's proposal rejects SD's motion (item 2) on gambling regulation, and S votes Yes in order not to strengthen SD's influence. Gambling regulation is not otherwise covered by the manifesto, but the SD clause is decisive and explicit.

citations.quote: The Social Democrats will never participate in giving power to the Sweden Democrats, a party that does not stand up for the equal worth and rights of all people.

motivering: The committee rejects 37 motions on public transport with reference to ongoing work. No named S motion item is found in this specific vote on paratransit (färdtjänst). The committee's reference to completed and ongoing initiatives is compatible with S's climate and accessibility goals without any direct conflict arising.

citations.quote: We want to give upper secondary school pupils and students the opportunity to travel free of charge on public transport during the summer.
Persons with disabilities shall be able to live their lives like others.

motivering: S prioritises defence against espionage and hybrid attacks. The committee's proposal criminalises foreign espionage but rejects the most far-reaching changes to the Code of Judicial Procedure (Chapter 27, Section 2), which provides a balance between security and the freedom of source disclosure (meddelarfrihet). S supports this moderate line, which maintains the criminalisation without maximum encroachment on press freedom.

citations.quote: We must be able to defend ourselves militarily, but also against hybrid attacks, espionage and cyberattacks. The Swedish people are a target of influence campaigns and disinformation.
We want to give public service constitutional protection. Media support shall create conditions for independent and locally rooted news reporting across the country.

omvarld.faktor: Russia's ongoing invasion of Ukraine
omvarld.effekt: Heightened intelligence threat from Russia reinforces the need for criminalisation of foreign espionage

motivering: S's manifesto demands that private health insurance shall not give priority access in publicly funded healthcare and that democratic control be reclaimed. The committee's proposal rejects the requirement that agreements with private healthcare providers who are also engaged by insurance companies shall ensure that the insurance assignment does not negatively affect the region's healthcare. This conflicts with S's clear line on control and transparency in healthcare, which is why the party votes no and supports reservation 1.

citations.quote: Those who have a private health insurance policy shall not be able to receive better or faster care in publicly funded healthcare.
Reclaim control over healthcare.

motivering: S's manifesto highlights the green transition as 'the defining issue of our time', with the goal of a fossil-free Sweden. The AP funds' investment policy is not explicitly covered in the manifesto, but the climate priority points toward supporting a ban on investments in fossil lobbying. There is tension with the pension commitment, but the urgency of the climate crisis formulation carries more weight. The party votes no against the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: The green transition is the defining issue of our time.
Sweden shall become the world's first fossil-free welfare nation.

motivering: S safeguards secure permanent employment and a strong position for wage earners. The Centre Party's motions on fixed-term employment, staffing agencies, and the posting of workers point toward a more deregulated labour market, which conflicts with S's line. Reservation 14 is likely C's own motion in support of its proposals, which is why S supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: more people should be able to work full-time in permanent jobs
A strong unemployment insurance fund (a-kassa) provides security in everyday life, strengthens wage earners' position in the labour market and helps stabilise the national economy during recessions.

motivering: S wants to restrict labour immigration and prevent immigrants from being exploited with low wages; a raised maintenance requirement is a direct tool for this. The party emphasises that domestic unemployed persons should be given priority. V's motion (y1) runs counter to this, and S should vote Yes with the committee.

citations.quote: Moreover, today's labour immigration often leads to people being exploited. We want to introduce a labour market test.
Labour immigration shall be restricted. In the first instance, unemployed people in Sweden should enter employment.

omvarld.faktor: High unemployment (7.7 %)
omvarld.effekt: Strengthens S's principle that domestic unemployed persons should be prioritised over expanded labour immigration

motivering: S has tightened migration policy and wants to stop tax fraud and welfare crime. A strengthened system for coordination numbers (samordningsnummer) with stricter identity checks counteracts abuse and is compatible with S's direction. V's motion 2 runs counter to this line, which is why S should vote Yes with the committee.

citations.quote: We have tightened migration policy, and this line is firmly maintained.
Tax fraud, welfare crime and money laundering shall be stopped.
citations.princip: stopping abuse of the welfare system

motivering: S views EU cooperation as the foundation for solving the major problems of the time and supports the implementation of EU directives. The copyright directive also strengthens the media's right to remuneration online, which aligns with S's support for independent news reporting. The motion on choice-of-law rules (y3) deviates from the directive's implementation and S should vote Yes with the committee.

citations.quote: We are convinced that EU cooperation is the foundation for solving many of the most difficult problems of our time.
Media support shall provide conditions for independent and locally rooted news reporting throughout the country.

motivering: The matter concerns distraint (utmätning) following inadequate credit assessment — V's motion 5. S's electoral manifesto does not cover this specific civil law question on credit assessment and enforcement law. Without a direct party position and without Reservation 4 carrying an S line, S follows the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: Sweden shall have secure insurance built on the idea of duty and right

motivering: Faster prosecution of crimes strengthens the chain of justice and is compatible with S's demand for an uncompromising fight against criminality. The committee's proposal rejects C's motion and S supports the more efficient criminal proceedings process. Swift prosecution is a natural complement to S's demands for tougher sentences and increased police presence.

citations.quote: The fight against criminality shall be uncompromising. Society's full force shall be mobilised to push back the criminals
Toughen the sentences to keep the criminals off the streets.
citations.princip: tougher sentences and an effective justice system

motivering: The committee's proposal files the written communications (skrivelser) and rejects M's and KD's motions, which implicitly criticise the previous S-led government's healthcare efforts. S defends its line of increased resources and strengthened healthcare, and rejects the current centre-right majority's demands. S's manifesto emphasises that no one should need to worry about receiving care in time.

citations.quote: No one should need to worry about receiving care in time. If a region does not meet the care guarantee as required by law, care shall be offered in another region.
Increase resources to welfare throughout the country.

motivering: S supports the implementation of global sustainability goals, but the manifesto does not specify how Agenda 2030 should be budgeted within the public administration appropriation. Without an S motion in the vote and without V's alternative clearly better reflecting S's principles, S follows the committee's line. S votes Yes.

citations.quote: The Covid-19 pandemic has hampered the implementation of the global sustainability goals. That work must now regain momentum.

motivering: The committee rejects S's own motion 28 (Lawen Redar et al.) on the distinctive character of non-profit associations. The manifesto establishes that popular adult education (folkbildning) provides strong democracy and that cultural life should be vibrant and free. The party supports Reservation 12, which carries the party's own position on civil society support.

citations.quote: Popular adult education (folkbildning) provides strong democracy and opportunities for personal development alongside formal education
Sweden shall have a vibrant, free and independent cultural life that both strengthens cohesion and challenges
citations.princip: vibrant cultural life and civil society

motivering: The proposals for increased transparency in the ownership of radio and television companies strengthen transparency in the media landscape. S safeguards independent and locally rooted news reporting and supports measures that increase public transparency in media companies. The committee's proposal to approve increased disclosure obligations and reject the motion against this is compatible with S's principled position.

citations.quote: We want to give public service constitutional protection. Media support shall provide conditions for independent and locally rooted news reporting throughout the country.

motivering: The manifesto establishes that defence appropriations shall be raised to 2 % of GDP and that military capability shall be powerfully strengthened. S's own motion (Hultqvist et al. motion 2) on military defence is rejected by the committee. S should vote No to support its reservation on increased military capability.

citations.quote: Appropriations to the military defence shall increase to the equivalent of two per cent of GDP.
Sweden needs to build a strong total defence (folkförsvar).

motivering: S's migration policy is restrictive and the party has not pushed for increased resources to migration courts as an end in itself. The committee's proposal to note the communication with a requirement for follow-up is reasonable and consistent with S's line. V's and MP's motions likely go further than what S's documents justify.

citations.quote: We have tightened migration policy, and this line remains firm.

motivering: The committee rejects SD's motion (Patrik Jönsson et al.) on the agency structure in the transport sector. S's manifesto does not specifically address the organisation of transport agencies; Reservation 50 is likely SD's own alternative. S supports the committee's line and rejects SD's counter-proposal.

citations.quote: The state shall be present throughout the country.

motivering: Criminalising foreign espionage in the Penal Code (brottsbalken) is a direct application of S's security-policy platform on countering espionage and hybrid attacks. S supported the proposal at the first vote in April 2022 and has no documented grounds for changing its position at the final adoption of these criminal-law amendments.

citations.quote: We must be able to defend ourselves militarily, but also against hybrid attacks, espionage and cyberattacks.
We want to continue international cooperation and develop cyber defence and intelligence capabilities.

omvarld.faktor: Russia's ongoing invasion of Ukraine
omvarld.effekt: Ongoing war reinforces the case for criminalising foreign intelligence operations against Sweden

motivering: S views EU cooperation as essential for addressing cross-border problems. The Commission's crisis instrument for the internal market aims to safeguard the EU's functioning in crisis situations — an instrument S supports in principle. The committee's proposal for a negative subsidiarity opinion (subsidiaritetsyttrande) would undermine the EU instrument's impact. S votes No and supports Alternative A.

citations.quote: We are convinced that EU cooperation is the foundation for solving many of the most difficult problems of our time. Not least the climate issue, migration and the threat from terrorism and cross-border crime.
citations.princip: EU as a necessary framework for cooperation

omvarld.faktor: Energy crisis and war in Ukraine create disruptions in the internal market
omvarld.effekt: Makes the need for an EU crisis instrument visible and strengthens S's rationale for not objecting to it

motivering: The rejected motions are SD's (Martin Kinnunen) demands on water management. S supports the EU's climate and environmental policy framework and would not support SD's divergent water management positions. S's manifesto gives no specific mandate for Reservation 27 and the party votes Yes and supports the committee's rejection.

citations.quote: The climate policy framework shall remain in place.
Sweden shall be a strong force in the UN and the EU for the world's countries to increase their commitments to realising the ambitions of the Paris Agreement.

motivering: S wants to remove secrecy barriers between agencies so that they can do their job. V's claim 4 on exemptions from the duty to report (underrättelseskyldigheten) undermines information-sharing between agencies and runs directly counter to S's principle. S should vote Yes with the committee and reject V's motion.

citations.quote: Secrecy barriers between agencies shall be removed so that the police and other professional groups can do their job.
Tax fraud, welfare crime and money laundering shall be stopped.

motivering: The manifesto emphasises that the state shall be present throughout the country and that the tax equalisation system shall secure high-quality public services throughout the country. S's own motion (Eriksson et al.) on the return of natural resource revenues is rejected by the committee. S should vote No to support its reservation and assert regional-policy interests.

citations.quote: The state shall be present throughout the country.
