The new law on coordination numbers (samordningsnummer) enables verification of biometric data in identity documents, which supports this goal. C's reservation 5, which presumably objects to the data storage, conflicts with SD's position; SD votes Yes.

citations.quote: biometric data, such as DNA data, on third-country nationals applying for a residence permit in Sweden should be collected and stored in searchable registers to a greater extent than today
Coordination numbers (samordningsnummer) that are not satisfactorily confirmed by the holder shall in due course be revoked.

motivering: No SD motion is included in the matter; alternative A is a reservation to C's motion on Visit Sweden AB. SD's election manifesto and the Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) contain no specific position on Visit Sweden AB. As a cooperation party in the Tidö agreement, SD supports the government's line and votes Yes with the committee's proposal.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties — the Sweden Democrats, the Moderates, the Christian Democrats and the Liberals — have agreed to take responsibility for Sweden in a joint collaboration during the 2022–2026 parliamentary term.
citations.princip: Cooperation party supports the government's line

motivering: SD's own motion 24 (Per Söderlund et al.) on the regionalisation of property tax is among those the committee proposes to reject, and the party has filed reservation 11 (alternative A). The election manifesto is explicit: 'The property tax levied on industrial and electricity-production facilities, we want to remain at the regional level.' The party votes No to support its reservation on the regionalisation of property tax.

citations.quote: The property tax levied on industrial and electricity-production facilities, we want to remain at the regional level.
• Regionalise the property tax from industrial and electricity-production facilities
citations.princip: Explicit demand for the regionalisation of property tax

motivering: SD supports export- and trade-promotion policy and wants to improve Sweden's position in the international market. The government's new objectives for foreign trade are consistent with SD's prioritisation of industry and competitiveness. The Tidöavtalet's (the Tidö agreement) budget commitment also confirms the Yes vote, and S's alternative motions are rejected in accordance with the coalition line.

citations.quote: Improve Sweden's position in the international market and in trade.
Prioritise Swedish industry and competitiveness.
The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed in the Riksdag.

motivering: The committee proposes a tillkännagivande (formal request to the government) against building high-speed rail — precisely what SD has pursued as a central infrastructure issue. The election manifesto is explicit: funding should be redirected from prestige projects to the upgrading of existing infrastructure. Despite SD's own motions on other infrastructure details being rejected, SD should vote Yes in order to secure the tillkännagivande against high-speed rail.

citations.quote: In light of the great needs in existing infrastructure, the Sweden Democrats consider it wrong to spend several hundred billion kronor on building new tracks for high-speed trains between the major cities of Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö.
The Sweden Democrats want to redirect prestige investments in high-speed trains to the more urgent need to upgrade transport infrastructure across all modes of travel.
Stop the plans for expensive high-speed rail between the major cities.

motivering: SD's documents lack a specific policy on children's right to culture in the sense intended by the S motion. SD emphasises that public cultural funding should reflect Swedish culture and its norms rather than drive the opposition's agenda. The committee's rejection of the S motion on children's and youth culture is consistent with SD's coalition role and fundamental direction of cultural policy.

citations.quote: Recognition of Swedish culture determines the demands placed on immigrants to integrate, the norms promoted by schools and public institutions, and how public funds are distributed to civil society and institutions.
It is also important to create better conditions for young people to find outlets for their interests and to encourage an active associational life.
citations.princip: support for young people's associational life

motivering: SD has its own motions in the property law report that the committee rejects: Martin Kinnunen et al., motion 3, and Mikael Eskilandersson et al., motions 2–6. The right to property is a constitutionally protected core value in SD's election manifesto. SD votes No to support Reservation 5, which presumably defends the party's motions on expropriation compensation and property rights.

citations.quote: Strengthen the constitutional protection of rights with regard to freedom of expression, the right to property and freedom from religion.
citations.princip: the right to property in the constitution

citations.quote: Strengthen the right to property.

motivering: SD is sceptical of global sustainability goals that can distort national priorities and burden the economy unnecessarily. Filing the communication without further binding measures is consistent with SD's principle of cost-effective climate policy. The rejection of V's motions for more Agenda 2030 measures is directly consistent with SD's position.

citations.quote: Reduce the costs of migration policy, foreign aid, EU contributions and climate measures that can be made more efficient.
Pursue an effective climate policy with a clear global perspective.

motivering: The committee rejects SD's own motions (Runar Filper items 1–5 and 7 and 1–2) on museum issues. SD emphasizes that 'public funds are distributed to civil society and institutions' with a focus on Swedish cultural identity, and the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) stipulates that 'a Swedish cultural canon shall be developed'. SD supports its own reservation (Alternative A).

citations.quote: The Sweden Democrats want to protect, preserve, and promote Swedish culture.

The recognition of Swedish culture determines what demands are placed on immigrants to integrate, what norms are spread by schools and public institutions, and how public funds are distributed to civil society and institutions.
A Swedish cultural canon shall be developed

motivering: SD has submitted a motion on the Agricultural Land Acquisition Act (jordförvärvslagen) (Martin Kinnunen et al., item 43), which the committee rejects. SD defends the right of ownership and that the rules in agriculture and forestry provide legally secure balancing of interests. Reservation 1 presumably defends SD's motion. SD votes No in accordance with the party's motion on agricultural land acquisition legislation.

citations.quote: The rules governing forestry and agriculture must also be reviewed to ensure workable balancing of interests, and the right of ownership should be strengthened.
citations.princip: right of ownership in agriculture and forestry

citations.quote: Strengthen the right of ownership

motivering: SD's integration policy is based on assimilation and requirements, not on the expanded integration programs that S (the Social Democrats) and MP (the Green Party) advocate in their motions on segregation. The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) prioritizes requirements-based integration and reformed settlement policy. The committee's rejection is consistent with SD's analysis that segregation is caused by failed integration policy, not a lack of additional programs.

citations.quote: To introduce a requirements-based integration policy, where those who reside in Sweden on a long-term basis shall take responsibility for becoming part of Swedish society.
Integration policy shall be based on assimilation and promote cohesion in the country.

motivering: The committee proposes to reject SD's own pension motions (Clara Aranda items 1–2; Mona Olin item 21), which forces SD to vote against the committee. SD wants to raise pensions and tighten requirements for newly arrived immigrants to access the pension system. The party votes No to signal its position and support the reservation that likely reflects SD's stance.

citations.quote: The Sweden Democrats want to strengthen the entire pension system and increase pension contributions. It should be reflected in the pension that one has worked a full lifetime.
citations.princip: raised pensions and a strengthened pension system

citations.quote: There is also a need for clearer incentives for those who have come to Sweden to work in order to then be able to participate in the Swedish pension system.
citations.princip: tightened requirements for newly arrived immigrants in the pension system

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) binds SD to support the government's budget. The committee's proposal to reject V's (the Left Party's) motion is consistent with SD's approach toward a secure but fraud-proof sickness insurance. SD's election manifesto emphasizes security, legal certainty, and combating welfare crime, which differs from V's more generous line.

citations.quote: The coalition parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
Work toward a secure and legally certain sickness insurance
Stop welfare crime within the social insurance system
citations.princip: stop welfare crime in the social insurance system

motivering: SD's documents do not specifically cover the question of a review of Lantmäteriet (the Swedish Mapping, Cadastral and Land Registration Authority). The committee refers to ongoing work and SD has no motions of its own in this matter. SD's general principle of demanding clear results for public investments does not point toward adding new investigation mandates. SD supports the committee's rejection in line with its coalition role.

citations.quote: The Sweden Democrats want to strengthen the possibility of holding decision-makers accountable when public resources are mismanaged. The Sweden Democrats also want to merge agencies and streamline public operations where possible.
Invest in welfare instead of political prestige projects

motivering: SD emphasizes that all modes of transport are important and criticizes car-hostile policies that burden low-income earners and rural residents with large subsidies for public transport. The motions from V (the Left Party), C (the Centre Party), and S (the Social Democrats) to increase the share of public transport promote a one-sidedly public transport-friendly agenda that SD does not share. The committee's rejection is consistent with SD's transport policy direction.

citations.quote: The Sweden Democrats consider that all modes of transport, including cars and air travel, are important for society to function.
citations.princip: all modes of transport treated equally

citations.quote: Most people cannot afford to buy a new car, yet are forced at the same time to pay for tax subsidies for those who can afford to buy expensive electric cars, and also to pay for large contributions to public transport through their tax bills.

motivering: SD's own motion item 7 (Tobias Andersson) on reduction of social security contributions is rejected by the committee. The election manifesto is explicit about reducing employer contributions and sick pay costs for small businesses. Voting No means supporting SD's own reservation 2 and fulfilling a clear election platform commitment.

citations.quote: Reduce employer contributions and sick pay costs for small businesses
citations.princip: reduced employer contributions for small businesses

citations.quote: Work for regulatory simplification and relieve small businesses' administrative burden
citations.princip: regulatory simplification and reduced cost burden

motivering: SD supports tax compliance and measures against fraud. Cash registers for amusement games (förströelsespel) are a tax procedure instrument that ensures correct reporting of gaming revenues, in line with SD's principle that public services shall be financed jointly and in solidarity. In the same committee report, however, SD rejected more intrusive marketing regulations, which illustrates the principled distinction.

citations.quote: The Sweden Democrats want to invest in strong welfare and public services throughout the country. For this to be possible, public services need to be financed jointly and in solidarity.
Tighten penalties for fraud within the welfare systems

motivering: The proposal to raise VAT (from 6% to 12%) on repairs is a government proposal. SD's election manifesto lacks a specific position on the VAT rate for repair services, but the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) obliges the coalition parties to vote for the government's budget in its entirety. The reservation from V (the Left Party) and MP (the Green Party) supports a lower rate for climate reasons, which SD does not prioritize over tax uniformity.

citations.quote: The coalition parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
The Sweden Democrats want to invest in strong welfare and public services throughout the country. For this to be possible, public services need to be financed jointly and in solidarity.

motivering: SD supports effective supervision and clear results from public investments in healthcare. The committee rejects the motion and supports the government's handling of the Swedish National Audit Office's (Riksrevisionens) recommendations on more effective pharmacy supervision. As a coalition party in the Tidö coalition's healthcare project, SD is bound not to unilaterally cooperate with the opposition on these issues.

citations.quote: Demand clear results for every public investment
The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally cooperate with other parties in the Riksdag on the issues covered by the directives of the cooperation projects.

motivering: The committee explicitly refers to the Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) and the 2023 budget as evidence that the government is addressing healthcare deficiencies — including queues, shortage of hospital beds, and staffing supply. SD is a co-author of the Tidö agreement and its detailed healthcare reform. Voting Yes confirms that SD's own political commitment is being fulfilled by the current coalition government.

citations.quote: The purpose of the project is to develop and implement concrete policy proposals that solve Sweden's most important societal problems within healthcare. The care queues need to be cut, accessibility needs to be improved, and equality between different parts of the country needs to be ensured.
citations.princip: healthcare reform through the Tidö agreement

citations.quote: A national long-term plan to elim inate the shortage of hosp ital beds shall
Increase the number of hospital beds

motivering: The committee majority adopts motions from C and S on wetlands and rejects SD's own motion (Martin Kinnunen et al., motion 20). SD's environmental policy emphasizes voluntariness and cost-effectiveness rather than parliamentary directives on expanded public investments. Reservation 16 represents SD's alternative position, and the party votes no to support it.

citations.quote: Experience shows that voluntary responsibility works best for creating environmental values, supported by competent and helpful advisory services.

Sweden Democrat environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most environmentally effective and cost-effective methods, while not harming industries and rural areas.

motivering: SD's election manifesto supports adapting copyright law to digital consumption and creation. The implementation of the EU directive strengthens rights holders' contractual position and regulates platform responsibility in line with this. V's reservation 5 (motions 2–5) likely deviates from the committee's position in a direction SD does not share; SD votes Yes to reject it.

citations.quote: Outdated rules on copyright also need to be adapted to how people consume and create content in the digital society
The Sweden Democrats want to prevent directives from the EU that threaten to determine what content may be provided through digital services and how material may be distributed on the Internet
citations.princip: Counter EU governance of digital content

motivering: SD's own motions 34 and 35 on civil defence are among the rejected motions, and the party has filed reservation 5 (alternative A). The election manifesto states that 'appropriations to the authorities with overall responsibility for civil defence, crisis management and preparedness should increase'. The party votes No to support its reservation on strengthened civil defence and preparedness.

citations.quote: Appropriations to the authorities with overall responsibility for civil defence, crisis management and preparedness should increase, and support for civil society organisations with public mandates shall be strengthened.
The Sweden Democrats want to strengthen society's preparedness for all types of crises that may arise.
The Sweden Democrats also want to re-establish emergency stockpiles to cover critical needs that may arise from various scenarios.

motivering: SD's documents do not cover home insurance or debt restructuring specifically. The committee rejects motions on compensation law and insolvency from an unidentified petitioner and Jennie Nilsson (S). SD has no motions of its own in the matter and has no reason to support S's reservation. The coalition role gives Yes as the default position.

citations.quote: the right to compensation, support and assistance when the crime has nonetheless occurred must be strengthened.
Raise the damages

motivering: The temporary electricity levy on producers' excess revenues is an EU-mandated budget proposal that SD, as a coalition party, is committed to supporting. The tax threshold (1,957 SEK/MWh) is substantially higher than current electricity prices (~840 SEK/MWh), meaning the tax will hardly affect nuclear power or other dispatchable electricity production during the period. The opposition's reservation for more far-reaching measures is not in line with SD's energy policy.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
Secure the supply of reliable and cheap electricity through investments in the nuclear power of the future.
citations.princip: support for nuclear power and low electricity prices

omvarld.faktor: Electricity price SE3 (0.84 SEK/kWh) well below the tax threshold of 1,957 SEK/MWh
omvarld.effekt: The levy does not in practice affect nuclear power or dispatchable electricity production during the March–June 2023 period, which resolves a potential tension with SD's nuclear power policy

motivering: SD and the other cooperation parties are running a joint healthcare project in which the future design of the Health and Medical Services Act (HSL) is included. The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) prevents SD from unilaterally supporting V's motions on the design of the Act. The committee's proposal to reject V's motions (motions 1, 2 and 4) is consistent with SD's coalition position.

citations.quote: The cooperation also means that the participating parties do not unilaterally collaborate with other parties in the Riksdag on the issues covered by the directives for the cooperation projects.
The purpose of the project is to develop and implement concrete policy proposals that solve Sweden's most important societal problems within Health and Medical Care.

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) commits SD to vote for the government's entire budget. The guidelines include a temporarily reduced fuel tax and a strengthened travel deduction, which aligns well with SD's election manifesto. The opposition reservations (V, S, C, MP) are rejected by the committee, which SD is to support in accordance with the budget agreement.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
Lower the price of petrol and diesel through reduced fuel tax and reduced reduction obligation.
Prioritize the interests of Swedish citizens in economic policy

omvarld.faktor: Inflation 10.9% (CPI annual rate)
omvarld.effekt: Temporary tax cuts on fuel and support for households are especially pressing and align with SD's priorities in the election manifesto

omvarld.faktor: Economic Tendency Survey 91.2 (below normal)
omvarld.effekt: The risk of recession justifies support for municipalities and regions, which is included in the budget SD is to support

motivering: The committee's proposal rejects Patrick Reslow et al. (SD) motions 1, 2, 14 and 18 on quality, conditions and pedagogical activities in preschool. SD should vote No to support its reservation (Alternative A). The election platform demands a maximum limit for children per adult and expanded Swedish Schools Inspectorate oversight, which SD's own motions aimed to enforce.

citations.quote: Increase requirements for independent preschools and expand the Schools Inspectorate's powers and inspections
Establish a maximum limit for the number of children per adult

motivering: The dormant proposal criminalises foreign espionage as a freedom-of-the-press and freedom-of-expression offence, and restricts the right of source confidentiality specifically for espionage. SD values freedom of expression, but this restriction concerns the protection of state secrets against foreign powers — not general press freedom. The security of the realm and SD's demand to counter external threats outweigh the narrow restriction of source confidentiality that the proposal entails.

citations.quote: The Sweden Democrats want to re-establish the total defence and for Sweden to have the capability to meet potential aggressors.
Strengthen the constitutional rights protection regarding freedom of expression, property rights and freedom from religion
citations.princip: constitutional protection of freedom of expression

motivering: The vote concerns the Centre Party's (C) motions on children's right to culture, influence and a safe internet environment (Reservation 11). SD's internet policy focuses on freedom of expression rather than C's rights perspective on children's influence and participation. As a support party for the government, SD follows the committee's rejection of the opposition's motions.

citations.quote: Protect freedom of expression online
citations.princip: freedom of expression on the internet

citations.quote: The internet and digital platforms have grown into the most important channel for democratic discourse and opinion formation. It is important to safeguard free debate and create equal conditions for all expressions that are permitted in a democratic society.

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) establishes that affected households shall receive a high-cost protection scheme for electricity. Confidentiality for data on electrical installations held by the Swedish Social Insurance Agency (Försäkringskassan) is necessary infrastructure for a functioning electricity support system. SD supports the government's proposal that enables the agreed support for affected electricity users.

citations.quote: A high-cost protection scheme for affected households and businesses as soon as practically possible — with retroactive payment.
Permanently reduce the tax on electrical energy to facilitate electrification

motivering: The committee's proposal rejects SD's own motion 12 (Mikael Eskilandersson et al. SD) on modernisation of the Bookkeeping Act. SD should vote No and support its reservation (Alternative A). The election platform demands regulatory simplification and cost-effective legislation for businesses, which motion 12 aimed to address.

citations.quote: Work for regulatory simplification and relieve the administrative burden on small businesses
New rules shall be cost-effective and existing rules need to be reviewed.

motivering: The Tidö agreement (Tidöavtalet) obliges the cooperation parties to vote for the government's budget in its entirety, which includes expenditure area 27 (the EU fee). Although the election manifesto expresses a desire to significantly reduce the EU fee, the Tidö agreement's budget commitment is binding and decisive. The EU fee is moreover a mandatory obligation under international law. The committee's proposal to approve the bill and reject the Centre Party's motions is therefore supported.

citations.quote: The cooperation parties commit to voting for the government's budget so that the budget as a whole is passed by the Riksdag.
citations.princip: budget commitment in the Tidö agreement

citations.quote: Significantly reduce Sweden's EU fee

motivering: The committee's proposal approves the motion by Thomas Morell et al. (SD, M, KD, L) to say no to building high-speed rail — exactly what SD advocates. SD votes Yes to support this tillkännagivande (formal request to the government) to stop costly new main lines and instead invest in existing infrastructure.

citations.quote: Stop the plans for expensive high-speed rail between the major cities

In light of the great needs in existing infrastructure, Sverigedemokraterna (the Sweden Democrats) consider it wrong to spend several hundred billion kronor on building new tracks for high-speed trains between the major cities of Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö.

motivering: The committee's proposal directly supports SD's own motion 1 (Jonas Andersson et al., SD) to reject the previous government's requirement for moderation in the marketing of gambling. citations.quote: Work for regulatory simplification and relieve the administrative burden on small businesses

motivering: SD lacks a specific policy on property formation (fastighetsbildning) but emphasises demands for clear results in public operations and efficient agency governance. The Swedish National Audit Office's recommendations are welcomed by the government with a focus on digitalisation, and the committee supports this line. As a support party to the government, SD follows the committee's proposal to note the written communication and reject the motions.

citations.quote: Demand clear results for every public investment
Stop wasteful spending within the agencies and merge agencies

motivering: The committee rejects the Social Democrats' motion on the protection of drinking water sources, citing ongoing work, which is in line with the governing coalition's position. SD's environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship (förvaltarskapstanken) and the Tidö agreement emphasises cost-effectiveness; the party supports the committee's assessment that work is already under way.

citations.quote: Our shared climate and environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most cost-effective measures, which at the same time do not harm industries and rural areas.

Sweden Democrat environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most environmentally effective and cost-effective methods, which at the same time do not harm industries and rural areas.

motivering: SD's documents lack a specific position on the conditions for student grants (studiemedel). As a support party outside the government, SD generally supports the committee's rejection of motions from C (the Centre Party) and S (the Social Democrats) on student support conditions. The orientation of higher education should be adapted to the needs of the labour market, not expanded on the opposition parties' terms.

citations.quote: Higher education should to a greater extent be adapted to the needs of a future labour market.
citations.princip: education tailored to labour market needs

citations.quote: Review public expenditure and redirect funds to welfare and the justice system

motivering: SD's own motion 15 on critical infrastructure is among the rejected motions, and the party has filed reservation 16 (alternative A). The election manifesto emphasises that 'disruptions to electronic systems, payment services or the electricity grid' may have 'unforeseeable consequences' and that society's vulnerability needs to be assessed. The party votes No to support its reservation on the protection of critical infrastructure.

citations.quote: Disruptions to electronic systems, payment services or the electricity grid can arise due to natural phenomena, attacks or faults and could have unforeseeable consequences relatively quickly.
citations.princip: Vulnerable critical infrastructure must be protected

citations.quote: Sverigedemokraterna (the Sweden Democrats) want to strengthen society's preparedness for all types of crises that may arise.
Sweden's self-sufficiency in energy, food and medical supplies needs to increase and be able to scale up quickly in the event of prolonged disruptions.

motivering: SD's environmental policy seeks cost-effective measures and takes a negative view of heavy new regulation such as that entailed by the Left Party's and the Green Party's motions for a marine environment act (havsmiljölag). citations.quote: Sweden Democrat environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most environmentally effective and cost-effective methods, which at the same time do not harm industries and rural areas.

citations.quote: Our shared climate and environmental policy is based on the concept of stewardship and strives to find the most cost-effective measures, which at the same time do not harm industries and rural areas.

motivering: The Tidö agreement binds SD to vote for the entire state budget including the expenditure ceiling, expenditure frameworks and revenue estimates. The fact that SD's own motions on alcohol and tobacco tax are rejected in section f) does not change the coalition commitment.

motivering: SD wants to protect, preserve and promote Swedish culture and emphasises the intrinsic value of the Swedish cultural heritage. The party's documents give no support for pursuing expanded repatriation through Riksdag decisions in line with the Centre Party's and the Green Party's motions. SD supports the committee's rejection, which is in line with the governing coalition's position.

motivering: SD's own motion 6 (Angelika Bengtsson) on exemption from social security contributions is rejected by the committee. citations.quote: Give the sports movements the conditions for continued vitality

SD is critical of politically motivated experiments aimed at children and young people and holds a conservative view of culture. citations.quote: End the political experiments on Sweden's children and young people
Create cohesion around Swedish culture and national identity

motivering: The Tidöavtalet (the Tidö agreement) obliges SD to support the government's budget.
